title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.


General Information:

• Reference: UOL08508 (to be mentioned in all correspondence)
• Publication date: -
• Contract Type: Permanent
• Working Hours:  
• Location: Belval Campus
• Planned starting date: 01/11/2026


Gender equality:

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

title: Launch MBA Program (m/f)
description:
Launch MBA Program
Job ID: 10552919 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Launch - Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe

Opportunities in locations including: the UK, Luxembourg, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden and the Netherlands. While we will consider location preferences if possible, we ask you to be as location-agnostic as possible since you may receive an offer from any of these corporate locations. Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program at time of application
• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results
• Comfortable with “hands-on” management of tasks, and proven ability to manage multiple, contending priorities simultaneously

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recru [...]

title: Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team (m/f)
description:
Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team

Location  Leudelange
Experience Level  Experienced
Home Office  Yes, partially possible

Your Job in a Nutshell

• Within our International Non-Life department, we are building a new Pan-European business branch operating under the Freedom of Service (FoS) regime.
• Our ambition: bring innovative insurance solutions to B2B partners across Europe — from MGAs and brokers to corporate clients seeking fronting solutions for their captives.
• As Data and Process Manager, you will play a key role in structuring and supervising the entire data process exchange for our international operations.
• You will also be in charge of building processes and optimizing them to create the most efficient organization. You will ensure that data provided by third-party are handled efficiently, compliantly, and in line with Baloise's best practices — a cornerstone of our competitiveness.
• You will work within a multidisciplinary international team operating in start-up and agile mode, reporting directly to the Head of International Non-Life.
• You will be part of an international team shaping a new line of business within a stable and reputable insurance group, with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on our European growth story.

What you can expect

Your main missions will be to:

Financial Management and Data Quality:

• Manage operational financial flows and work closely with Finance teams to ensure the timely and accurate transmission of data.
• Ensure the consistency and reliability of technical and financial data, notably by overseeing proper data reconciliation with actuarial teams and collaborating with partners to enhance the integrity of incoming data flows.

Operational and Cross-Functional Support:

• Coordinate operations across internal teams and external partners.
• Support claims management, fraud investigations, and customer complaints handling, while assisting in the design and deployment of operational processes with partners.
• Collaborate with legal and technical stakeholders whenever required.
• Take ownership of cross-functional topics and urgent requests that have not yet been allocated within the team, stepping in where necessary to ensure business continuity and the successful delivery of activities across functions.
Process Management and Cross-Functional Coordination:
• Define, formalize, document, and continuously improve business processes, including underwriting, claims management, data flows, and reporting.
• Actively manage workflow automation and digitalization initiatives in close collaboration with IT and data teams.
• Ensure that processes comply with applicable regulatory requirements.
• Identify operational pain points and drive problem-solving and process optimization initiatives.
• Act as a central coordination point between operational teams, IT, Finance, and external partners.
• Foster collaboration and ensure seamless coordination across teams to address operational challenges.
• Ensure the timely implementation of IT solutions with our partners and proactively remove any delivery blockers.
• Contribute to the implementation or enhancement of tools and systems supporting operational management.
• Identify opportunities for operational improvement and lead process optimization projects.

What we expect

• Master's degree (or equivalent, Bac+5) in Management, Engineering, Finance, Insurance, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in a cross-functional role, with exposure to operational processes, technology, finance, data management, and business operations
• Proven experience in an international and/or multi-country environment is highly desirable
• Strong organizational, problem-solving and analytical skills, with a continuous improvement mindset
• Proven ability to thrive in complex, multicultural environments, ideally within agile or fast-growing organizations.
• Fluency in English (working language); additional European languages (French, German, Spanish) are an asset
• SQL language proficiency

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe. In addition to our traditional financial business, we are also broadening our range with ecosystems in the areas of mobility and home. We see the digital age as an opportunity to make our offering even more sustainable, innovative and customer-oriented in the future. Are you shaping it with us?

We give you the freedom to pursue your ideas. Get involved! Question us! Develop yourself and us even further! Our culture of learning and making mistakes as well as communication at eye level all make this possible. Because only together can we move forward.

title: Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies (m/f)
description:
Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies
Job ID: 10566721 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

As an engineer on our team, you will take on a key role in improving capabilities of the Amazon product search service, and ensure we offer top-quality recommendations for all our customers regardless of their location or language. We help customers find the products they are searching for, and discover new products they would be interested in, by developing ML models trained on terabytes of product and traffic data to improve query understanding, ranking of search results, and personalization. We are seeking a software engineer who will assist in deploying those ML models, integrating them into existing services, and optimizing their performance. You will do so by building robust pipelines to train, evaluate, and deploy our models.

This is a rewarding role where you will be able to draw a clear connection between your work and how it improves the experience of millions of Amazon customers across the globe every day. You can also expect to have excellent opportunities, and ample support, for career growth, development, and mentorship. The team is a mixed science/engineering group, with each team member able to contribute to both engineering excellence as well as scientific innovation.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement new features across the various software components powering our search system
- Participate in the design and deployment of robust and scalable pipelines for data processing, model training, and model inference
- Build and configure metrics, dashboards, and alerting mechanisms for our deployed services and models
- Work closely with ML experts on your team to identify improvement opportunities and tackle technical obstacles
- Coordinate with engineering counterparts in other teams and stakeholders we work with

A day in the life

You will collaborate with scientists who build ML models trained on terabytes of data, and integrate these models into the production search engine that serves customers, closing the loop through design, implementation, deployment, and monitoring. The chosen approaches for model architecture will balance business-defined performance metrics with the needs of millisecond response times.

About the team

EU International Technologies is an organization focused on accelerating the EU Stores business by delighting customers and selling partners. The team's mission is to innovate locally and scale worldwide, fostering a world-class community of builders that delivers with speed and agility. EU INTech operates across domains including consumer discovery, search, selection, partner growth, pricing, sustainability, and marketplace expansion. The culture emphasizes collaboration, inclusion, technical excellence, big bets on high-impact projects, transparency, and long-term ownership -- empowering engineers and scientists to solve complex problems at international scale.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field
- 3+ years of professional software development experience
- 1+ year of experience in building large-scale pipelines for data processing and ML model training/inference
- Strong coding and problem-solving skills in at least one modern programming language such as Python, Java, C++, etc.
- A general understanding of essential machine learning concepts (with no expectation of in-depth ML knowledge)
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including code reviews, build processes, testing, and deployment

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field
- Professional experience with AWS services (e.g. S3, EC2, Lambda, EMR, DynamoDB)
- Prior experience within a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers
- Experience with NLP applications or search/retrieval engines
- Fluency in one or more languages other than English

Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program at time of application
• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results
• Comfortable with “hands-on” management of tasks, and proven ability to manage multiple, contending priorities simultaneously

title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
description:
Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F) – Région Liège-Luxembourg

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.
• Une expérience significative dans le pilotage et le delivery de missions complexes, depuis le cadrage stratégique jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Une expérience solide auprès de CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, avec la capacité à intervenir comme interlocuteur de confiance sur des problématiques stratégiques et techniques.
• Une réelle capacité à développer du business : identification d'opportunités, développement de comptes, construction de propositions commerciales, soutenances et développement de nouvelles missions.
• Une forte capacité à développer et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des décideurs de haut niveau.
• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial, avec l'envie de construire, structurer et faire grandir une activité.
• Une excellente communication, une forte posture de conseil et une capacité à embarquer clients et équipes.

title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

• Coordinate underwriting and credit performance topics, assessing implications for conversion, credit losses, volumes, customer experience and profitability.  
• Support key Business Line steering and governance forums, ensuring topics are properly structured, decisions are prepared and agreed actions are followed through.  
• Connect stakeholders across Riverty, creating alignment between functions and ensuring complex initiatives move forward.  
The scope reflects the core responsibilities in the underlying role profile across enablement, strategy, development, business cases, underwriting and governance.  

What You'll Bring

• Around 5 years of professional experience in consulting, strategy, business development, project/program management, financial services, corporate finance or a comparable cross-functional role.  
• Proven ability to drive complex projects across multiple stakeholders, including where you do not have direct authority over the teams involved.  
• Strong analytical capabilities and experience with business cases, financial modelling and management decision support.  
• Ability to structure complex and ambiguous problems and turn them into clear actions and decisions.  
• Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, combined with commercial thinking and a hands-on approach.  
• Confidence working with senior stakeholders and the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.  
• Experience in payments and/or consumer credit is a plus, but not a prerequisite.  
• Fluent English

Why This Role?

Pay & Credit sits at the intersection of product, commercial, finance, credit risk and operations. That puts you at the center of some of Riverty's most important business questions.
Working directly with the Business Line Lead, you will gain significant exposure to the strategic and financial steering of Pay & Credit, while building a broad network across Riverty and developing an end-to-end understanding of the business.  
Your mandate: connect the dots, create structure, enable decisions and drive execution — while helping shape where Pay & Credit goes next.

We want to be a fair and inclusive employer. We value the diverse perspectives that a diverse workforce brings to the table. Therefore, we are actively looking for people who enrich our company through their identity, background and personal experiences, with or without a disability.

title: Treasury Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Treasury Manager (m/f/d)

• 43, Boulevard Pierre Frieden, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time

Company Description

Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don't have to worry about it.

And there's more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

As part of the continued build-out of our Treasury function in Luxembourg, we are looking for a Treasury Manager to play an active role in the implementation and execution of treasury activities, including liquidity management, cash management, treasury trading, risk monitoring, and process development. This role will contribute to establishing robust treasury processes, controls, and operating procedures within a regulated banking environment.

We are looking for a

Treasury Manager (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) Join our team at our location in Luxembourg – flexible working conditions are available

Your responsibilities:

• Participate in the implementation and continuous enhancement of Treasury processes, controls, and operating procedures.
• Establish and maintain treasury workflows covering liquidity management, treasury trading, hedging activities, and cash management.
• Manage daily liquidity positions and cash balances to ensure adequate liquidity levels.
• Monitor, manage, and optimise nostro account balances and related cash flows.
• Prepare and monitor short- and medium-term liquidity forecasts.
• Execute treasury transactions, including money market placements, FX transactions, hedging transactions, and securities trades.
• Monitor and analyse liquidity, foreign exchange, interest rate, counterparty, and concentration risks arising from treasury activities.
• Calculate and monitor liquidity and risk metrics, including LCR, NSFR, liquidity gaps, and other treasury-related indicators.
• Ensure treasury activities are performed in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies.

Qualifications

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
• 3+ years of relevant experience in Treasury, Liquidity Management, Financial Markets, or a comparable role within a regulated financial institution.
• Hands-on experience in cash management, liquidity monitoring, money market transactions, FX operations, securities trades, and nostro account management.
• Experience in calculating, monitoring, and analysing liquidity and risk metrics, including LCR, NSFR, liquidity gaps, and treasury-related risk indicators.
• Familiarity with CSSF requirements and applicable European regulatory frameworks affecting treasury activities.
• Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment and collaborate effectively with Finance, Risk, Operations, and other stakeholders.
• Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.

Additional Information

Who we are

XXXX (XXXX) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. XXXX enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The XXXX service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, XXXX will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

www.XXXX.lu | XXXX on LinkedIn

Purpose of the job / project

Ready to play a key role in shaping the future of health data access and trusted data sharing in Luxembourg and beyond?
Join our team and contribute to strategic national and European initiatives that advance secure, compliant, and efficient access to data for research, innovation, and public policy. You will support flagship projects such as but not limited to, HDAB2-LU, which is enabling the establishment of the Luxembourg Health Data Access Body and laying the foundations for a robust health data ecosystem aligned with European data-sharing frameworks.

As a Senior Data Steward, you will contribute to the development of data governance practices, data access services, and project-related solutions that facilitate secure data sharing, strengthen health and research data ecosystems, and promote the responsible adoption of trustworthy AI. Your work will directly contribute to XXXX's mission of unlocking the value of data while ensuring transparency, compliance, and public trust.

As a Senior Data Steward, you will drive the development and delivery of the data access request management capacity. This includes the collection and validation of access conditions from different data providers, standardising the information into data request application form, defining the access review procedure and SOPs, compiling requirements of data access management tools, supporting the implementation of the tools to and implementing the data access request management workflows in the tools. You will work with the other project team members from XXXX, including Project Coordinator, Work Package Leaders, Data Protection Officer (DPO) and ethical, legal and societal implications (ELSI) experts to implement the required compliance measures related to the projects. Finally, you will interact with the information security, technology, and data teams to ensure adequate design and delivery of services.

What you will do

• Develop and deliver XXXX' DM/DS services within the scope of the projects
• Contribute to other services and the maintenance of XXXX' DM/DS toolbox.
• Develop guidelines on data management, stewardship and protection for the projects
• Contribute to the XXXX' Data Catalogue by populating, curating, and updating metadata related to data custodians, provenance and use restrictions for datasets of the projects
• Implement necessary General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) accountability measures for data processing activities involving personal data required by the projects
• Perform Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) for data processing activities concerning sensitive data for the projects
• Provide training on DM/DS best practices, tools, and related to the DS services of the projects
• Develop internal processes and guidelines to support relevant information security and data protection compliances and certifications related to the projects
• Engage in (inter-)national projects related to DM/DS service development related to the projects
• Train and supervise less experienced team members working on the projects

Who you are

• MSc or PhD in natural science or technology, or social science with technical skills.
• 5 to 10 years of relevant experience, including relevant ones in the following areas:
          - data stewardship
          - data management
          - community coordination, outreach and training.
• Working knowledge in data lifecycle management, FAIR data principles (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reuse) and the GDPR
• Experience in technical writing (white papers, documentation, reports, policies) and content for dissemination to stakeholders and the public (online guides, tutorials)
• Good working knowledge of one programming language (Python or R)
• Good working knowledge of command line shell (any OS)
• Good working knowledge of basic website authoring (markdown, jinja, HTML)
• Proven experience in one of the following topics:
          - Ethical, legal and societal implications in data-driven research projects
          - Designing and implementing organisational risk management processes
          - Data requests management of sensitive data
          - DPIA
         - Community building and management
• Excellent verbal communication skills in English.
• Service and collaborative attitude
• Ability and willingness to interact closely with stakeholders
• Ability to handle multiple assignments while working independently and effectively under deadlines

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The XXXX is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.  
Join XXXX and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact. Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative. Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

title: Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer (m/f)
description:
Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer to join to the internal Finance department.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

Position Summary

The Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer is responsible for optimizing the Company's cash flow by managing accounts receivable, reducing credit risk, improving collection performance, and supporting treasury activities. The role combines operational cash collection, credit risk management, reporting, business partnering, legal recovery coordination, and continuous process improvement.

What will you do?

Cash Collection & Accounts Receivable

• Manage customer accounts, handle accounts receivable, and ensure the timely collection of outstanding invoices.
• Coordinate reminder campaigns and follow up on payment commitments.
• Escalate overdue cases in line with the Cash Recovery Policy.
• Negotiate payment arrangements and coordinate legal recovery when required.
• Resolve payment issues in collaboration with Partners, Project Managers and client teams.

Credit Risk Management

• Implement a client credit rating system.
• Maintain and update client and group risk ratings.
• Monitor payment behaviour, financial exposure and insolvency indicators.
• Recommend credit terms, collection strategies and risk mitigation actions.
• Monitor customer insolvency risks, in particular by conducting checks with the Luxembourg Commercial Register (LBR).

Cash Management & Reporting

• Produce dashboards and KPI reports (DSO, ageing, cash collection, risk ratings, exposure, legal recovery and forecast accuracy).
• Contribute to the preparation of PowerBI reports.
• Present analyses and recommendations to Management and the Cash Recovery Committee.

Business Partnering

• Advise Partners and business teams on receivable management and credit risk.
• Promote timely billing, proactive collections and effective dispute resolution.
• Ensure compliance with the Company's Cash Recovery Policy and applicable legislation.

Process Improvement & Governance

• Continuously improve collection processes, reporting, workflows and internal controls.
• Contribute to the digitization of processes, particularly through AI.
• Maintain the Cash Recovery Policy, credit procedures and risk models.
• Coordinate with Partners, Treasury, Finance and external legal advisors.

Shared Service Center Coordination

• Act as the primary liaison between Luxembourg and the AR Team in Morocco.
• Occasional travels to Morocco to strengthen collaboration, monitor performance, deliver training and ensure consistent application of Finance procedures.

This position is for you if:

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent.
• Minimum 7 years' experience in Accounts Receivable, Credit Control or Cash Management.
• Experience in a professional services environment is an asset.
• Team management.

Technical Skills

• Strong accounting and credit management knowledge.
• Advanced Excel skills; IA, Power BI and ERP experience are an advantage.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg accounting and VAT principles.

Personal Skills

• Analytical and results-oriented.
• Strong negotiation and communication skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management.
• Organized, proactive and detail-oriented.
• Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams and cultures.

Languages

• English and French required.
• German and/or Luxembourgish are considered assets.
…then this offer is probably made for you!


What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave

• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

title: Senior GNSS Geodesy Researcher / R&D Specialist (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:


Project Context:

PLANTFix (Positioned canopy tying through integrated navigation with automated fastening technology) is an advanced R&D project backed by the Ministry of the Economy in Luxembourg. The project focuses on developing an open, low-cost, multi-frequency GNSS receiver stack with RTK and PPP-AR capabilities tailored for precision viticulture, agricultural robotics, and autonomous machinery.


Role Summary:

LuxGeospatial is seeking a Senior GNSS Geodesy Researcher / Navigation R&D Specialist to lead the positioning core and firmware stack development for our agricultural navigation module. You will bridge cutting-edge geodetic signal processing with embedded hardware integration. Working closely with internal engineering teams and external partners (including Trier University of Applied Sciences, the University of Luxembourg, and CLEMENS Technologies), you will ensure centimetre-level positioning performance, sub-millisecond deterministic timing, and high operational integrity under challenging field conditions.


Key Responsibilities:

1. GNSS Receiver Integration & RF Design:

- Integrate and qualify multi-frequency, multi-constellation OEM GNSS modules (e.g., u-blox F9 series or Septentrio mosaic family) onto compact carrier boards.
- Manage RF partitioning, low-noise amplification (LNAs), power regulation, disciplined clocking (TCXO/OCXO), and pre-compliance EMC/EMI troubleshooting.


2. RTK & PPP-AR Algorithm & Firmware Development:

- Implement and optimize Real-Time Kinematic (RTK) and Precise Point Positioning with Ambiguity Resolution (PPP-AR) correction clients via NTRIP and SSR streams.
- Formulate robust integer ambiguity resolution algorithms (LAMBDA family), advanced cycle-slip detection, multipath metrics, and RAIM-like integrity suites (quality flags, protection levels, and residuals).
- Design and optimize embedded firmware in C/C++ on RTOS environments, alongside Python pipelines for scientific modeling, data analysis, and RINEX parsing.


3. Deterministic Timing & Synchronization:

- Design and verify hardware 1PPS (One Pulse Per Second), PTP (Precision Time Protocol / IEEE-1588), and low-jitter time-sync architectures to achieve sub-millisecond alignment with downstream actuation and perception controllers.


4. Open API & Middleware Bindings:

- Define, document, and maintain Interface Control Documents (ICD) and data bindings across UART, SPI, CAN, Ethernet, and Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2).


5. Field Testing & Consortium Validation:

- Design experimental test plans, collect and process large-scale RINEX raw observation logs, and benchmark against CORS networks.
- Execute winter georeferenced post-surveys and field trials under canopy and on steep slopes alongside academic and industrial project partners.

Contraintes:
• Autre:Occasional outdoor field testing and travel to partner sites (Trier/Greater Region)


Profil:

Doctorat
Géodésie GNSS, Ingénierie Géomatique, Navigation par satellite, Génie électrique, ou un domaine technique scientifique étroitement lié.

Autres compétences:

Maîtrise de la programmation C/C++ pour les systèmes embarqués et de Python.
Connaissance des systèmes d'exploitation temps réel (RTOS), du middleware ROS 2 (Robot Operating System), et des bus de communication matériels standards (UART, SPI, CAN, Ethernet).

title: AML Compliance Analyst – Expert·e Banque Privée (m/f)
description:
AML Compliance Analyst – Expert·e Banque Privée(H/F)

Description du poste

Type de contrat
CDI

Temps de travail
Temps plein

Activités / Missions

Présente au Luxembourg depuis plus de 100 ans, la Banque de Luxembourg est un acteur financier incontournable de la place au service de clients privés, des entreprises luxembourgeoises et de clients professionnels issus des métiers de la gestion d'actifs. Certifiée B Corp depuis 2023, notre Banque s'engage à renforcer l'impact social, sociétal et environnemental de ses activités.

Mission

Vous êtes animé.e par la curiosité, le sens du détail et l'analyse de dossiers complexes ? Vous souhaitez jouer un rôle clé dans la protection d'une institution financière de premier plan ? Rejoignez notre département Compliance ! Au quotidien, notre équipe AML/FT veille activement à la mise en œuvre de la politique de lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent et le financement du terrorisme au sein de la Banque de Luxembourg.
En tant que AML Compliance Analyst, votre rôle consiste à gérer le volet opérationnel de la lutte AML-FT : vous prenez en charge l'analyse et la gestion des risques liés à la lutte contre le blanchiment et le financement du terrorisme. Ce poste vous positionne au cœur de l'investigation financière : comprendre les enjeux, décrypter des schémas, assembler les pièces de dossiers complexes et analyser les flux financiers constitueront le cœur de vos missions.

Au quotidien, vos responsabilités seront les suivantes :

Analyse et gestion des risques AML/FT

• Vous guidez et assistez les conseillers.ères de notre département Banque Privée en matière de lutte contre le blanchiment et le financement du terrorisme avec pédagogie et réactivité.
• Vous prenez en charge l'analyse et vérifiez la conformité des dossiers de notre clientèle Banque Privée et Entreprises & Entrepreneurs (processus d'ouvertures de comptes, revues périodiques, revues transactionnelles, etc.…)
• Vous êtes garant.e de la mise en œuvre de la politique AML/FT au sein de la Banque, vous veillez à la sensibilisation de nos collaborateurs.trices, et vous agissez en tant que relais compliance au quotidien.
• Vous êtes un.e des interlocuteurs.trices auprès des autorités règlementaires (CSSF, Parquet, CRF…) ;

Amélioration des flux et des solutions

• Vous êtes force de proposition et participez à différents projets en lien avec la conformité au sein de la Banque ;
• En tant que conseiller.e AML/FT, vous participez à la mise en œuvre des projets Compliance en collaboration avec vos collègues et les autres équipe de la Banque ;
• Vous participez au design du modèle de gestion AML/FT au sein de la banque entre les différentes équipes Client Data Management, les équipes commerciales et le département Compliance ;

Profil

Doté.e d'une expérience dans une fonction similaire, vous souhaitez valoriser vos connaissances auprès d'une nouvelle structure qui vous permettra de mettre à profit votre expertise et de participer au projet de développement de la gestion AML/FT au sein de la banque.

• Vous êtes (f/h) titulaire d'un Master en droit et/ou sciences économiques/financières ;
• Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans une fonction compliance AML idéalement au sein d'un cabinet de conseil / Big 4 ou d'un grand organisme financier ;
• Vous avez une très bonne connaissance des règlementations AML/KYC/FT et des risques y associés, notamment dans le domaine de la Banque Privée ;
• Vous êtes doté.e d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse ainsi que d'une grande rigueur ;
• Vous faites preuve d'une grande aisance relationnelle et rédactionnelle ;
• Vous êtes proactif.ve, faites preuve d'esprit d'initiative et participez à l'amélioration des flux pour une meilleure efficacité au sein de l'équipe ;
• Vous êtes titulaire du M1 Compliance. Le M2 constitue un atout.
• La connaissance du système bancaire AVALOQ est un plus.
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais. La pratique de l'allemand constitue un avantage.

Convaincus que notre diversité fait notre force, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de la Diversité, Lëtzebuerg. Attentifs à l'égalité des chances, nous nous engageons à travers des actions concrètes, notamment en faveur des jeunes talents, des femmes, des collaborateurs seniors…

Vous souhaitez …

• rejoindre des équipes composées de femmes et d'hommes d'horizons multiples, aux parcours et compétences complémentaires,
• vous développer dans un cadre de travail respectant l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle ;
• évoluer dans un environnement propice à l'épanouissement de tous les talents…

Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette description et souhaitez nous rejoindre ?
N'attendez plus et adressez-nous votre CV accompagné d'une lettre de motivation via notre Espace Candidats, nous serons ravis d'échanger avec vous !

Avant la conclusion du contrat de travail, un extrait du casier judiciaire (bulletin n°3), datant de moins de 2 mois, vous sera demandé, uniquement à titre de consultation, afin de garantir votre honorabilité au regard de la fonction à pourvoir.

title: Senior infrastructure Engineer (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Description:


How will you contribute?

You will support the operation and continuous improvement of LIST's Linux infrastructure (including user endpoints and IT services), ensuring reliable, secure and efficient environments for research and organizational activities.

Working within the IT Infrastructure team, you will:

·          Administer, maintain and continuously improve LIST's backup, storage and file-service infrastructure.
·          Operate the Commvault backup platform, including policies, schedules, retention, reporting and capacity management.
·          Monitor backup jobs, perform recovery tests, and support disaster-recovery and business-continuity procedures.
·          Administer storage infrastructure and file services supporting SMB shares, VMware and other infrastructure workloads.
·          Manage storage capacity, performance, availability, resilience, data protection and lifecycle activities.
·          Monitor infrastructure hardware and services, including servers, storage, virtualization, backup and network-related components.
·          Maintain relevant monitoring dashboards, alerting rules, service indicators, thresholds and operational reports.
·          Investigate and troubleshoot incidents, failures, alerts, performance issues, capacity constraints and hardware problems.
·          Perform or coordinate upgrades, patching, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, replacements and decommissioning.
·          Contribute to capacity planning, performance optimization, service continuity and infrastructure architecture improvements.
·          Maintain accurate technical documentation covering configurations, procedures, dependencies, recovery requirements and escalation paths.



Additional infrastructure responsibilities:

Under the guidance of IT Infrastructure colleagues, you will also provide support for:

·          Active Directory operations, including user and computer administration, group management, access control and directory hygiene.
·          Telephony and unified-communications services, including operational support, maintenance, lifecycle activities and service improvements.

You will collaborate closely with IT Operations, Information Security, Applications and Development teams, researchers, external service providers and other stakeholders to ensure secure, reliable and efficient IT services


Project delivery and activity management:

In addition to day-to-day engineering and operational support, you will contribute to IT and infrastructure projects delivered through internal initiatives and in collaboration with external partners or clients.
You will manage your activities in accordance with LIST's project-management methodology by planning and prioritizing tasks, estimating effort, tracking progress, managing dependencies and risks, coordinating stakeholders and delivering agreed outcomes. Depending on the assignment, you may also coordinate or manage IT or LIST-level projects involving multidisciplinary teams.


Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!


Education:

·          Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field experience


Experience and skills:

·          Minimum of 5–7 years of professional experience in infrastructure operations, systems administration or a comparable IT environment.
·          Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise backup and recovery platforms, preferably Commvault.
·          Practical experience with backup policies, retention, monitoring, recovery procedures, recovery testing and disaster-recovery operations.
·          Experience administering or supporting enterprise storage systems, file services and storage technologies for virtualisation or infrastructure workloads.
·          Experience with infrastructure monitoring, including service availability, hardware health, capacity, performance and alert management.
·          Experience with infrastructure maintenance, lifecycle management, patching, vulnerability remediation and service continuity.
·          Experience supporting Active Directory or other identity and directory services is an advantage.
·          Experience with VMware or comparable virtualisation technologies is an advantage.
·          Experience operating or supporting enterprise telephony, unified communications or related services is an advantage.
·          Good understanding of infrastructure-security practices, including hardening, access control, vulnerability remediation, encryption and data protection.
·          Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and firewalls.
·          Experience with scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible or equivalent is an advantage.
·          Experience supporting cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS is an advantage.
·          Ability to work in accordance with internal IT policies, security requirements and operational standards.
·          Experience using project-management and collaboration tools such as Asana, Jira, Microsoft Planner or equivalent.


Soft skills:

·          Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting abilities
·          Collaborative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
·          Project-oriented and delivery-focused mindset, including the ability to plan, prioritize, coordinate and report on activities.
·          Strong documentation, communication, planning and organizational skills.
·          Proactive approach and willingness to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, efficiency and user experience.
·          Ability to prioritize tasks and respond effectively to incidents and operational requirements.
·          Ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
·          Ability to work independently while recognizing when to seek guidance or involve specialist colleagues.


Language skills:

•               Fluency in English (Luxembourgish, German and especially French are considered as an asset), both oral and written.


Your LIST benefits:

·          An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·          Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·          Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·          An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
·          Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
·          Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·          Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·          Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
·          32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·          Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers


Apply online

Your application must include:

·          A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
·          A CV with contact details
·          Contact details of 2 references
