title: Trumling/Efterbearbetning
description:
Vi söker en engagerad medarbetare till trumlingsavdelningen!

Är du praktiskt lagd, noggrann och trivs med att arbeta inom industrin? Vill du ha ett varierande arbete där kvalitet och precision står i fokus? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig!

Arbetstider: 2-skift

Vi söker nu en engagerad och arbetsvillig medarbetare till en av våra kunder, där du kommer att arbeta på deras trumlingsavdelning med trumling och efterbearbetning av industriella detaljer.

Om tjänsten

Som medarbetare inom trumling och efterbearbetning arbetar du med att rengöra, bearbeta och polera detaljer för att säkerställa att de håller rätt kvalitet. Arbetsuppgifterna kan bland annat bestå av att hantera industritvättar, köra trumlingsprocesser och kontrollera detaljer efter avslutad bearbetning.

Trumling är en viktig del av tillverkningsindustrin och innebär att detaljer bearbetas i en roterande eller vibrerande trumma tillsammans med slip- eller polermaterial. Genom processen kan grader avlägsnas, kanter jämnas till och detaljernas ytor förbättras. Det bidrar till en jämnare ytfinish och säkerställer att detaljerna uppfyller de kvalitetskrav som ställs.

Arbetet kräver därför att du är noggrann, har öga för detaljer och förstår vikten av att följa rutiner och instruktioner. Du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor för att säkerställa ett bra slutresultat.

Vi söker dig som:

    Har B-körkort.
    Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och arbetsvillig.
    Trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team.
    Har ett tekniskt intresse och gärna erfarenhet från industrin.
    Är flexibel och har möjlighet att arbeta 2-skift.
    Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

Tidigare erfarenhet från industri, CNC eller liknande arbete är meriterande, men inget krav. Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personlighet och söker framför allt dig som har rätt inställning, är pålitlig och vill utvecklas i din yrkesroll.

Vi erbjuder

    Ett varierande och praktiskt arbete inom industrin.
    Möjlighet att lära dig nya arbetsuppgifter och utvecklas i din roll.
    Trevliga kollegor och en bra arbetsmiljö.
    Möjlighet till ett långsiktigt arbete för rätt person.

Låter detta intressant?

Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, så vänta inte med att söka.

title: Verksamhetsfokuserade chefer till soldat- och underhållsutrustning
description:
Vi söker två enhetschefer som vill vara med och driva vårt arbete kopplat till soldat och underhålls-utrustning framåt. Hos oss får du möjlighet att använda din kompetens där den verkligen gör skillnad. Tillsammans med ett kompetensbrett team är du med och skapar lösningar som gör avtryck – både idag och i framtiden.

Om tjänsten

Som chef inom verksamhetsområdet Logistikmateriel på soldat- och underhållsutrustning leder du utvecklingen av verksamheten och har en nyckelroll i att omsätta Försvarets materielverks (FMV:s) mål i konkreta resultat och långsiktig utveckling. Du bidrar till att stärka FM:s förmåga genom att säkerställa att verksamhetens initiativ och leveranser håller hög kvalitet och skapar nytta utifrån uppdragets behov.

Med ett tydligt och tryggt ledarskap skapar du engagemang, delaktighet och riktning. Du ger dina medarbetare förutsättningar att utvecklas och prestera, samtidigt som du driver verksamheten framåt genom tydliga prioriteringar, välgrundade beslut och effektiva arbetssätt. Du har ett strategiskt helhetsperspektiv och ansvarar för att planera, styra och följa upp verksamheten. Du väger samman kostnad, kvalitet, risk och nytta för att använda resurser och kompetenser effektivt och nå uppsatta mål.

Som chef företräder du FMV:s vision, mål och värdegrund. Du har verksamhetsansvar, arbetsgivaransvar och ekonomiskt ansvar samt säkerställer att verksamheten bedrivs enligt gällande regelverk och riktlinjer. Du bidrar aktivt till ledningsgruppens arbete och utvecklar verksamheten i linje med FMV behov och långsiktiga mål.



Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm. Resor förekommer inrikes och utrikes.



Om dig

Vi söker dig som har relevant akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande utbildning eller kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt som vi bedömer likvärdig. Du har chefserfarenhet eller erfarenhet från en arbetsledande roll, exempelvis som projektledare, inom kvalificerad verksamhet. Du har erfarenhet av att leda och följa upp verksamhet samt av budgetansvar, ekonomisk planering och uppföljning. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha kunskap om ekonomistyrning, resursprioritering och uppföljning. Du kan uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska. Tjänsten ställer krav på att du kan arbeta i Officepaketets olika verktyg.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av offentlig upphandling eller inköp samt av materielförsörjning till Försvarsmakten. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av FMV:s och/eller Försvarsmaktens verksamhet. Har du kunskap om FMV:s och Försvarsmaktens kund- och beställarrelation samt de regelverk som styr denna, ser vi det som en fördel. Det är även meriterande om du har kunskap om processer, styrning och arbetssätt inom statsförvaltningen.

Personliga egenskaper är av stor vikt för oss och vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Som chef hos oss leder du verksamheten med tydlig riktning och målmedvetenhet. Du säkerställer att både kortsiktiga och långsiktiga mål nås genom strukturerat arbete, ansvarstagande och förankring hos medarbetarna. Du bygger tillitsfulla relationer och främjar en inkluderande, respektfull arbetsmiljö där engagemang, gemenskap och mångfald står i centrum. Med stabilitet, mod och integritet tar du ansvar för beslut och handlingar, leder med värdegrund i fokus och agerar tryggt även i utmanande situationer. Genom strategisk helhetssyn prioriterar och samordnar du resurser, driver förbättringar och stärker myndighetens långsiktiga utveckling och förtroende.



FMV – Försvarets materielverk

På FMV är du med och bidrar till att göra Sverige och världen säkrare. Vi har i uppdrag att förse det svenska försvaret med den senaste tekniken och kunskapen så att de kan försvara vårt land och våra allierade. Tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor får du vara med och utveckla och upphandla det som ibland inte existerar än. Du driver utvecklingen, hela vägen från behov till leverans. Från idé till verklighet.



Du kommer att arbeta på vårt verksamhetsområde logistikmateriel som ansvarar för materiel och tjänster inom bland annat logistikstöd, personlig utrustning och fältförplägnadssystem till Försvarsmakten.



Hos FMV erbjuds du en trygg anställning med bra förmåner:

• Kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter

• Flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet till distansarbete i den mån arbetet tillåter

• Tjänstepension och friskvårdsbidrag

Läs mer om FMV som arbetsgivare och om de förmåner vi erbjuder på vår hemsida: https://www.fmv.se/jobb--karriar/arbeta-pa-fmv/.



Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens försvar? Välkommen med din ansökan senast 4 november 2026.



Bra att veta

• Du ansöker genom att bifoga ditt CV, betyg och intyg på svenska.

• I ditt CV beskriver du tydligt på vilket sätt du uppfyller efterfrågade kvalifikationer och meriter. För att skapa en mer inkluderande rekryteringsprocess ber vi dig att inte skicka personligt brev eller inkludera bild i ditt CV.

• Vi rekryterar kompetensbaserat och bedömer kandidater utifrån rollens krav på erfarenhet, kunskap och personliga egenskaper.

• I urvalsarbetet kan vi komma att genomföra tester med stöd av extern leverantör.

title: Mekanikkonstruktör till Finspång
description:
Om jobbet

Vill du arbeta med mekanikkonstruktion inom tekniska utvecklingsprojekt? Vi söker en erfaren mekanikkonstruktör till ett uppdrag hos vår kund i Finspång.

Du arbetar med stålkonstruktioner och installationsdesign, från konstruktion i NX till tillverkningsunderlag och teknisk dokumentation. Uppdraget omfattar både forskning och utveckling, R&D, och arbete i pågående industriprojekt.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

    

Konstruera stålkonstruktioner och ta fram installationslösningar.

    

Arbeta med mekanikkonstruktion i NX.

    

Ta fram ritningar och tillverkningsunderlag.

    

Upprätta och uppdatera teknisk dokumentation.

    

Utveckla konstruktionslösningar utifrån projektens tekniska krav.

Vem är du?

    

Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik eller motsvarande relevant område.

    

Cirka 5–10 års erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion.

    

Erfarenhet av konstruktion i NX.

    

Kunskap om PED och ASME.

    

Goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Villkor

Anställning: Du anställs som konsult hos Q Sverige. Uppdraget är långsiktigt med goda möjligheter att på sikt bli anställd direkt hos kundföretaget. Placering: Finspång.

Allmänt

Vi genomför urval löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Ansök via länken i annonsen.

title: Psykolog eller kurator med KBT-kompetens – Vårdcentralen Drottninggatan
description:
Psykolog eller kurator med KBT-kompetens – flexibel tjänst med digital gruppbehandling

Vårdcentralen Drottninggatan – Linköping

Vill du arbeta på en modern och växande vårdcentral där du får möjlighet att utveckla nya arbetssätt inom psykisk hälsa?

Vårdcentralen Drottninggatan söker en engagerad och självständig legitimerad psykolog eller kurator med KBT-kompetens som vill kombinera individuellt patientarbete med digital gruppbehandling.

Hos oss får du en varierad tjänst med stor möjlighet att påverka behandlingsupplägg, arbetstider och verksamhetens utveckling.

Om tjänsten

Vi erbjuder en tjänst på 80–100 %, med önskad omfattning omkring 90 %, där arbetet huvudsakligen fördelas mellan:

    60 % digital behandling: Strukturerad KBT i grupp via videomöten i realtid, framför allt för patienter med ångest, stress, sömnsvårigheter och annan lindrig till måttlig psykisk ohälsa.
    40 % mottagningsarbete: Individuella bedömningar, samtalsbehandlingar, uppföljningar och samarbete med övriga professioner på vårdcentralen.

Vi ser gärna ett upplägg med cirka tre digitala arbetsdagar och två dagar på mottagningen per vecka, anpassat efter tjänstgöringsgrad och verksamhetens behov.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för evidensbaserad psykologisk behandling och som uppskattar ett självständigt, strukturerat och utvecklingsinriktat arbete.

Kvalifikationer:

    Legitimerad psykolog eller relevant utbildning för arbete som kurator.
    Dokumenterad KBT-kompetens och erfarenhet av psykoterapeutiskt behandlingsarbete.
    God förmåga att självständigt bedöma, planera, genomföra och följa upp behandling.
    God kommunikativ förmåga och mycket god svenska i tal och skrift.
    Förmåga att arbeta effektivt med bibehållen kvalitet och patientsäkerhet.

Meriterande:

    Grundläggande psykoterapiutbildning med KBT-inriktning för sökande med kuratorsbakgrund.
    Erfarenhet av grupp-KBT och digital behandling.
    Erfarenhet från primärvård.
    Intresse för verksamhetsutveckling och digitala arbetssätt.

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Konkurrenskraftig och individuellt anpassad lön.
    Möjlighet till distansarbete.
    Flexibel tjänstgöringsgrad mellan 80 och 100 %.
    Stor självständighet och möjlighet att utveckla egna behandlingsprogram.
    Ett engagerat multiprofessionellt team och korta beslutsvägar.
    Moderna arbetsverktyg och digitalt dokumentationsstöd.
    En arbetsplats med fokus på kvalitet, tillgänglighet och god arbetsmiljö.

Anställningsvillkor

Arbetsplats: Vårdcentralen Drottninggatan, Drottninggatan 10, Linköping

Omfattning: 80–100 % enligt överenskommelse

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning, eventuell inledande provanställning

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Lön: Individuell lönesättning

Ansökan

Välkommen att skicka ditt CV och ett kort personligt brev där du beskriver din erfarenhet av KBT, digital behandling och eventuellt gruppbehandling.

Ange gärna önskad tjänstgöringsgrad och löneanspråk.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Vårdcentralen Drottninggatan – en modern vårdcentral med patienten i centrum.

title: Distributionschaufför
description:
Distributionschaufför

Som distributionschaufför har du en viktig roll i logistikkedjan och ansvarar för att paket och varor når privatpersoner och företag på ett säkert, effektivt och professionellt sätt.

Arbetet är aktivt, självständigt och varierande. Du utgår vanligtvis från en terminal där du förbereder dagens rutt, sorterar och lastar försändelser i fordonet innan du påbörjar dina leveranser. Under arbetsdagen använder du förarapp och navigationssystem för att genomföra rutten och registrera leveranser.

Som chaufför är du företagets ansikte utåt och har daglig kontakt med kunder och mottagare. Rollen ställer därför höga krav på service, ansvarstagande och ett professionellt bemötande.

Arbetet sker ofta i ett högt tempo där du behöver kunna planera din tid, arbeta effektivt och självständigt lösa situationer som kan uppstå under arbetsdagen.

Arbetsuppgifter

    

Leverera paket och varor till privatpersoner och företag

    

Köra skåpbil eller lätt lastbil

    

Sortera, lasta och lossa försändelser

    

Planera och genomföra tilldelade leveransrutter

    

Hantera och registrera leveranser via förarapp

    

Säkerställa att leveranser genomförs korrekt och inom utsatt tid

    

Ge ett professionellt och serviceinriktat bemötande

    

Hantera avvikelser och problem som uppstår under rutten

    

Ansvara för fordon, utrustning och gods under arbetspasset

    

Rapportera skador, avvikelser och andra händelser enligt gällande rutiner

    

Bidra till hög leveranskvalitet och kundnöjdhet

Vi söker dig som

    

Har giltigt B-körkort

    

Talar och förstår svenska

    

Är punktlig, pålitlig och ansvarstagande

    

Trivs med ett aktivt arbete och högt tempo

    

Kan arbeta självständigt och strukturerat

    

Är lösningsorienterad och kan fatta egna beslut

    

Har ett trevligt och professionellt kundbemötande

    

Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten

    

Tar ansvar för både leveranser, fordon och utrustning

Meriterande

    

Erfarenhet av bud-, transport- eller distributionskörning

    

Erfarenhet av att köra skåpbil eller lätt lastbil

    

Erfarenhet från lager eller terminal

    

Truckkort A och/eller B

    

God digital vana och erfarenhet av förarappar eller liknande system

Tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande men inte alltid ett krav. För rollen är ansvarstagande, punktlighet, arbetsmoral och förmågan att leverera med hög kvalitet särskilt viktigt.

title: Vehicle Software Integration Engineer
description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Vehicle Software Integration & Fault Tracing Engineers (2 Positions)

Sweden work Authorization visa is mandatory and no visa sponsorship is available. Please DO NOT apply if you don't have any existing Sweden visa.

Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for two experienced Vehicle Software Integration & Fault Tracing Engineers for a long-term automotive engineering assignment in Sweden.

We are seeking hands-on engineers with strong expertise in embedded software integration, vehicle diagnostics, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges in automotive systems, we would like to hear from you!

🔧 Key Responsibilities

    Perform vehicle software integration and software updates.
    Conduct embedded software diagnostics, troubleshooting, and fault tracing.
    Identify root causes of software-related issues in complex vehicle systems.
    Analyse vehicle communication, network behaviour, and system interactions.
    Diagnose and troubleshoot issues related to vehicle electronics and embedded systems.
    Document findings and report results using established engineering tools and processes.

✅ Required Qualifications

    Several years of hands-on experience in embedded software integration.
    Proven experience in fault tracing, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis of complex embedded systems.
    Practical experience with diagnostic and analysis tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, or equivalent.
    Experience with SWDL tools for vehicle software downloads and updates.
    Strong understanding of vehicle communication networks and embedded software architectures.
    Experience with engineering and collaboration tools such as SystemWeaver, Jira, Confluence, or similar.
    Valid C or CE driving licence.

⭐ Meritorious: Experience working with Linux environments.

📍 Assignment Details

    Location: Västra Götaland County, Sweden
    Work Mode: On-site (remote work is not available)
    Expected Start Date: 26 October 2026
    Duration: Approximately 14 months
    Number of Openings: 2
    Sweden work Authorization visa is mandatory and no visa sponsorship is available.
    Ability to join immediately/on a short notice

📩 Interested?

If your experience matches the requirements and you are interested in this opportunity, please send us your updated CV along with your availability and relevant experience.

Feel free to share this opportunity with qualified professionals in your network.

title: Integration Test & Validation Engineer
description:
Job Description

We are looking for an Integration Test & Validation Engineer to join a growing technical team in Gothenburg. This position will be responsible for providing overall services and test support to our SE Site in terms of TSP infrastructure, functional capabilities, and information security.

Key Responsibilities

• Validate system interactions and data consistency between:

o TSP backend services (Microservices)

o Vehicle side (TCU/TCAM/In-Vehicle Infotainment)

o Mobile applications (iOS/Android)

• Actively query and verify databases (SQL/NoSQL) to ensure data integrity, correct state transitions, and accurate business logic flow during integration.

• Analyze backend logs and APM tools (e.g., Kibana, Splunk) to identify root causes of business errors, communication failures, and API mismatches.

• Investigate data flow and communication between systems to ensure correct orchestration and messaging.

• Design and execute integration test scenarios covering real-world use cases (e.g., remote commands, vehicle status, OTA, eCall, and remote diagnostics).

• Support defect analysis and troubleshooting, bridging the gap between frontend, backend, and vehicle teams to drive complex cross-functional issues to closure.

• Collaborate closely with backend developers, vehicle teams, and app teams in an international environment.

• Verify API behaviors, message flows, and communication protocols (e.g., MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, Protobuf).

• Prepare test reports, validation documentation, and quality assessments for release readiness.

Requirements & Technical Proficiency

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in integration testing, joint debugging, or system validation, preferably in the telematics or connected vehicle domain.

• Deep understanding of connected car business logic and architecture (TSP / TCAM / Mobile App interaction flow).

• Proficient in database operations, with the ability to write SQL queries independently (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle) for data verification and troubleshooting.

• Proven experience in log analysis and issue investigation across distributed systems (e.g., tracing a remote command failure from App, TSP, Vehicle).

• Solid knowledge of networking and communication protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, MQTT, or other messaging queues.

• Familiarity with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, JMeter, curl) and log management tools (e.g., ELK stack, Kibana). Preferred Qualifications• Experience within OEM or Tier-1 automotive telematics projects (e.g., handling T-Box/TCU registration, activation, or TSP lifecycle management).

• Familiarity with common backend business error codes and exception handling mechanisms.

• Basic scripting skills (Python, Shell) for log parsing, data preparation, or test automation support.

• Experience with cloud-based backend systems (e.g., AWS, Azure) and microservices architecture. Personal attributes• Strong analytical mindset with a structured, end-to-end problem-solving approach.

• Excellent communication and coordination skills, with the ability to effectively drive joint- debugging sessions across different technical teams.

• Proactive, self-driven, and highly quality-oriented.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken) for daily collaboration in international teams.

What We Offer

A supportive and learning-oriented work environment

Opportunity to gain hands-on experience in IT operations within the automotive domain

Career development path towards IT Manager or other IT roles

Competitive salary and benefits in accordance with Swedish standards

Du arbetar självständigt med research, interaktionsdesign och prototypframtagning samtidigt som du trivs i tvärfunktionella team. Du är även nyfiken på hur AI kan bidra till effektivare designarbete och mjukvaruutveckling.

Arbetsuppgifter 🎯

• Planera och genomföra användarundersökningar, kartlägga användarresor och identifiera förbättringsområden.

• Förenkla komplexa arbetsflöden som omfattar affärsregler, produktdata, rumsliga begränsningar och 3D-modeller.

• Samarbeta med utvecklare, produktansvariga och andra UX-specialister kring design och tekniska lösningar.

• Arbeta med designsystem och återanvändbara designkomponenter för att säkerställa skalbarhet och enhetlighet.

• Minst 5 års erfarenhet som UX Designer med fokus på komplexa digitala produkter.

• God erfarenhet av designsystem och interaktionsdesign.

• Förmåga att samarbeta med utvecklare, produktansvariga och andra intressenter.

Meriterande krav ⭐

• Erfarenhet av komplexa verksamhetssystem, retail eller kommersiella planeringslösningar.

• Erfarenhet av datarika arbetsflöden, rumslig planering eller 3D-baserade digitala produkter.

• Erfarenhet av UX-design för flera användargrupper och internationella marknader.

• Erfarenhet av att utveckla nya digitala produkter från grunden eller förbättra befintliga lösningar.

• Erfarenhet av AI-stödda designprocesser och mjukvaruutveckling.

title: Facility Manager - Sales Market Sweden
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As Facility Manager, you will enable and secure the operations of H&M Group’s retail portfolio in Sweden by delivering optimized, qualitative and cost-efficient Facility Management services that support business needs and asset performance. You will own the full FM scope, steer suppliers and service delivery, maintain accurate asset and maintenance data, and translate business needs into effective facility plans and investments. You will combine operational excellence with lifecycle planning, data-driven follow-up and continuous improvement across the portfolio.

Key responsibilities include :

    FM scope and category ownership: Act as the FM Category Manager, owning your FM categories end-to-end: defining strategy, standards, steering suppliers, managing performance, and driving cost and quality optimization across the portfolio.
    Sourcing, Procurement & Contract Delivery: co-lead sourcing and procurement of services, and secure contractual compliance and high-quality service delivery from current facility providers and landlords.
    Maintenance Planning & Execution: Create and maintain facility plans that balance preventive and reactive work and meet internal and external requirements.
    Data, Systems & Financial Performance: Ensure accurate asset, maintenance and project data across facility management systems to manage budgets, forecasts, and quality performance through structured follow-up
    Energy Management: drive energy efficiency reduction initiatives to optimize energy efficiency and drive cost-reduction initiatives

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

​You will work closely with the Expansion team (Construction Project Managers, Facility Managers, Lease managers, Legal Counsels and Controllers) as well as Sales Teams (Store Operations, Area Managers and Store Teams) in addition to suppliers, contractors and landlords. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues in our Global Construction & Facilities function, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver consistent, high-quality facility services.

WHO YOU ARE​

You are a proactive and structured Facility Management professional with strong technical understanding, commercial thinking and analytical capabilities. You are communicative, consultative and collaborative, with a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach. You are data-driven and methodical in planning and follow-up, while remaining resilient and flexible in a dynamic environment.

We are looking for someone who has at least 5 years of experience within Facility Management, Construction, Real Estate or a related field. You have proven experience in supplier, contract and FM category management, as well as budgeting and operational planning. You are comfortable working in CAFM systems and are proficient in MS Office. You have a Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. You have a proven track record in activity-based budgeting and operational planning, and are fluent in Swedish and English. A background from the retail industry and experience in large international organization are meriting.



WHO WE ARE​

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

If you feel your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, apply by sending your application in ENGLISH through the career site as soon as possible but no later than October 31st. As we review applications continuously, the role may be closed early.  

This is a permanent full-time position. The position is based in our Office in Stockholm and reports to the Expansion Manager.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.​

The assignment focuses on contributing technical expertise in Microsoft Fabric, BI and data platform migration, and AI-assisted development while supporting and evolving existing BI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

    Contribute to the migration of BI solutions and data platforms from an on-premises environment to a cloud-based platform.
    Develop, maintain, and enhance Business Intelligence solutions using Microsoft technologies.
    Work with the existing BI landscape, including data integration, semantic models, reporting, and analytics solutions.
    Apply Microsoft Fabric capabilities to support the target data platform and modern BI architecture.
    Use AI-assisted development practices to improve development efficiency and solution delivery.
    Collaborate with the established BI team throughout the migration and modernization initiative.

Technical Stack & Requirements

    Microsoft Fabric
    Microsoft SQL Server
    SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS)
    SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)
    SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)
    Power BI
    Experience with BI and data platform migration
    Experience with AI-assisted development

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal candidate is an experienced BI Developer with demonstrated hands-on expertise in Microsoft Fabric and migration of BI and data platforms. Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server, SSAS, SSIS, SSRS, and Power BI is required. The candidate must also have experience using AI-assisted development methods.

title: Piping Supervisor
description:

We provide all travel arrangements as well as accommodation while working on site. The work rotation will be 4 weeks on site in Sweden, followed by 2 weeks off. The start will be as soon as possible and the estimated duration is until the end of May 2027.

The open position is within our Energy Transition business unit, where we help our customers improve the reliability of their production facilities and enhance maintenance operations. We deliver demanding project implementations for industrial projects. We develop digital solutions to improve productivity, manage the overall maintenance and reliability of our customers' production plants and provide resource and contracting services as well as subcontracting chain management services for domestic and international industrial projects.

* Oversee and ensure proper planning and execution of piping work, including problem-solving and quality control
* Support reporting activities and daily coordination
* Onboard blue-collar workers to site operations and tasks

* Monitor and coordinate HSE activities
* Coordinate with scaffolding supervision and ensure manlift availability

Requirements:
* Technical educational background
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the industrial sector, particularly piping installation

* Good interpersonal skills
* Proactive attitude

Are you up for the challenge? Come and create the best customer experiences with us!

title: Reverse Supply Chain RTV Coordinator
description:
Shape the Future of Reverse Supply Chain Excellence at Axis

At Axis Communications, we don't just lead the global market in network video - we innovate, challenge boundaries, and set new standards. Our products and solutions are at the forefront of making the world smarter and safer. Success here is driven by our passionate and skilled employees, bold enough to think differently and deliver cutting-edge results.

Now, we're looking for a RTV (Return To Vendor) Coordinator to join and grow with our Reverse Supply Chain (RSC) team at our headquarters in Lund, Sweden. The Reverse Supply Chain team ensures excellent customer service by managing returns and repairs in the aftermarket, maintaining a smarter, safer and more sustainable world. This is a unique opportunity to make a powerful impact in a world-class organization.

Your Future Team - Supply Chain professionals with a strong sense of collaboration
You'll be joining a dynamic and talented team of RMA (Return Material Authorization) Supply and Reverse Logistics professionals, all working towards one common goal: delivering exceptional service by ensuring product availability at the right time and place. Our team operates with a strong sense of collaboration and cross-functional influence across Axis' supply chain, from strategy to execution. Together, we are committed to driving efficiency and optimizing processes for a smarter, safer, and more sustainable world.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will work with delivering and coordinating Axis' service offerings to our customers. Together with your team, you will be responsible for the efficient setup and execution of the reverse supply chain within a complex and dynamic environment.

Your work will involve close collaboration with a broad network of internal and external stakeholders. The role involves a significant amount of administrative work and requires a structured approach, high accuracy, and strong attention to detail. Your primary responsibilities will include:

Repair Flow & Order Management - Managing, coordinating and following up on repair and return orders from RMA partners to EMS (factory) providers and back, including order creation, shipment tracking, delivery follow-up, and resolution of logistics deviations.
Return Order Coordination - Creating, monitoring, and securing timely execution of return orders, ensuring accurate order status, proactive communication with stakeholders, and adherence to agreed lead times
ERP System Accuracy & Administration - Maintaining and administering accurate master data, and operational metrics within the ERP system.

However, this role goes far beyond supply and reverse flow planning. One part of your responsibility will be to participate but also drive continuous improvement initiatives - aimed at enhancing processes and collaboration across the organization.

Who You Are
We are looking for a self-driven individual with a positive mindset. You are a strong team player who also thrives when working independently, focusing and like to dig into numbers and managing your own tasks effectively.

You are energized by challenges, take initiative, and love to collaborate within a team. You enjoy working in a fast-paced, innovative environment and are motivated by the opportunity to make a real impact.

You are structured, adaptable, and capable of maintaining a detailed perspective, enabling you to make smart, efficient decisions in both the short and long term.

What We Expect:
Education within Supply Chain or a related field.
Experience in administrative and coordinating work
Good knowledge about Excel.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English & Swedish

What We Appreciate:
Experience with aftermarket operations or reverse logistics.
Experience in Supply Chain Management within a global organization.
Knowledge in ERP systems.

Why Axis? - A Culture That Values Impact and Growth
At Axis, you'll find more than just a job. You'll be part of a culture that rewards creativity, promotes continuous development, and values individual contribution. We offer a career in a fast-paced, global company that's constantly evolving, where you'll have the autonomy to lead, innovate, and see the direct impact of your work.

We want you to enjoy working with us, which is why we offer benefits such as morning "fika" every day, Friday cake, company bonus, wellness allowance, health insurance and your very own Axis bicycle - to name a few.

Ready to Drive Change?
This is your opportunity to join an industry leader and make a tangible difference. We are excited to hear from professionals who are ready to take ownership of their role and drive transformation in a global supply chain environment.

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

Submit your application latest by October 31st. For any questions, contact our recruiting manager Stefan Grönvall at

Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments. Notice will be provided before we take any action.

title: Rekrytering Servicechef
description:
Finnvedsbostäder AB är ett allmännyttigt bostadsbolag som ska bidra till en fungerande bostadsmarknad. Finnvedbostäder ägs av Värnamo kommun med det huvudsakliga ändamålet att främja bostadsförsörjningen i kommunen, och är idag en verksamhet som ska bedrivas enligt affärsmässiga principer. I uppdraget ligger också att ha en strategiskt hållbar förvaltning och fastighetsutveckling för attraktiva boenden – både idag och imorgon. Vi kan idag stolt summera ett fastighetsbestånd på över 3 000 bostäder och lokaler.

Servicechef till Finnvedsbostäder i Värnamo

Vill du vara med och skapa attraktiva, hållbara och välskötta boendemiljöer?

På Finnvedsbostäder tror vi att ett attraktivt bostadsområde handlar om mer än byggnader. Det handlar om gröna och välskötta utemiljöer, trygga och inbjudande mötesplatser och ett långsiktigt arbete för hållbarhet och trivsel.

Nu söker vi en servicechef som vill leda och utveckla arbetet med våra utemiljöer och serviceområden. Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett genuint intresse för människor med ett engagemang för utemiljö, hållbarhetsfrågor och utveckling av attraktiva bostadsområden.

Om rollen

Som servicechef har du det övergripande ansvaret för bolagets grönytor, sophantering, löpande drift och felavhjälpande underhåll inom ansvarsområdet.

Tillsammans med dina medarbetare arbetar du för att våra bostadsområden ska vara välskötta, trivsamma och attraktiva för våra hyresgäster.

Du leder en grupp på 14 medarbetare och är en synlig och närvarande ledare i verksamheten. Du finns nära det dagliga arbetet, skapar engagemang och delaktighet samt arbetar aktivt för att utveckla både verksamheten och medarbetarna.

Vi söker dig som ser möjligheter före problem och som drivs av att arbeta förebyggande och långsiktigt snarare än att enbart lösa uppkomna situationer. Du har förmågan att skapa en kultur där medarbetarna arbetar proaktivt, tar ansvar och känner stolthet över resultatet.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

    Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetarna i den dagliga verksamheten.
    Planera och prioritera arbetet för att skapa attraktiva, välvårdade och trygga bostadsområden.
    Driva utvecklingen av våra utemiljöer med fokus på trivsel, kvalitet och hållbarhet.
    Arbeta aktivt med frågor kopplade till biologisk mångfald, hållbar förvaltning och nya miljökrav.
    Ansvara för bolagets källsorterings- och miljöstationer och utveckla arbetet kring hållbar resurshantering.
    Planera och följa upp verksamhetens budget, mål och resultat.
    Säkerställa att verksamheten använder maskiner, fordon och utrustning på ett effektivt och säkert sätt.
    Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt som stärker både service, kvalitet och arbetsmiljö.
    Samverka med områdeschefer och övriga funktioner för att skapa bästa möjliga boendemiljö för våra hyresgäster.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är en trygg, engagerad och handlingskraftig ledare. Du trivs ute i verksamheten, bygger starka relationer och motiverar andra att utvecklas och ta ansvar.

Du har ett genuint intresse för utemiljöer, trädgård, skötsel och utveckling av gröna miljöer. Du ser värdet i välplanerade och välskötta bostadsområden och förstår hur de bidrar till både trivsel, trygghet och hållbarhet.

Som person är du initiativrik och lösningsorienterad. Du arbetar strukturerat och långsiktigt och har förmågan att omsätta idéer till konkreta förbättringar i vardagen.

Vi ser gärna att du har

    Flera års erfarenhet av ledarskap med personalansvar.
    Erfarenhet av att leda operativ verksamhet inom utemiljö, park, grönyteskötsel, fastighetsservice eller liknande område.
    Erfarenhet av budget- och resultatansvar.
    Intresse för trädgård, anläggning, hållbarhetsfrågor och utveckling av boendemiljöer.
    Förmåga att planera, organisera och följa upp verksamhet på ett strukturerat sätt.
    Kunskap om eller intresse för biologisk mångfald, hållbar förvaltning och cirkulärt tänkande.
    B-körkort.

Därför ska du välja Finnvedsbostäder

Här får du möjlighet att påverka hur framtidens boendemiljöer ska utvecklas i Värnamo kommun. Du blir en viktig del av arbetet med att skapa attraktiva, hållbara och välskötta bostadsområden där människor trivs, känner trygghet och vill bo kvar länge.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

I denna rekrytering samarbetar Finnvedsbostäder (https://www.finnvedsbostader.se/)med Fasticon. Du söker tjänsten via annonsen. För att säkerställa att dina personuppgifter hanteras i enlighet med GDPR tar Fasticon inte emot ansökningar via e-post. Vi arbetar utifrån en kompetensbaserad rekryteringsprocess med fokus på att rekrytera rätt kompetens utifrån verksamhetens behov.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Jenny Tell på jenny.tell@Fasticon.se (mailto:jenny.tell@Fasticon.se)

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Så länge annonsen är publicerad tar vi emot ansökningar. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess använder vi oss av tester samt att en anställning hos Finnvedsbostäder föregås alltid av en bakgrundskontroll och drogtest.

Om Fasticon

Fasticon är marknadsledande specialister på kompetensförsörjning inom fastighetsrelaterade kompetenser. Vi kombinerar skarp expertis med en djup förståelse för ledarskapsutmaningar och hjälper organisationer att hitta rätt kompetens för långsiktig framgång.

Våra kunder finns över hela Sverige och vi utgår från Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö.

Läs mer på www.fasticon.se (http://www.fasticon.se/) och sök lediga tjänster på www.fasticon.se/lediga-jobb (http://www.fasticon.se/lediga-jobb).

title: Consultant Psychiatrist – Welcome to Sweden!
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Would you like to work as an psychiatrist in an engaged and supportive team where job satisfaction, collaboration, and professional development are at the heart of everything we do?

Then this position within psychiatric outpatient care in Sweden could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Here, you will find a safe and welcoming workplace with broad multidisciplinary expertise, where they work together to make a real difference for their patients every day.

About the workplace

You will become part of a well-coordinated and skilled team consisting of doctors, psychologists, psychiatric nurses, social workers, occupational therapists, and medical secretaries who work closely together. The clinic also offers mobile services, increasing flexibility and accessibility for patients.

We regularly host students and trainees, which contributes to a dynamic and stimulating learning environment. Our culture is built on mutual respect, teamwork, and continuous improvement. They are also developing digital care solutions to complement traditional consultations.

Patient safety, quality, and a healthy work-life balance are always top priorities.

Your responsibilities

As a Consultant Psychiatrist, you will be responsible for the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of patients, in close collaboration with other professionals in the team. An important part of the role also involves cooperation with other healthcare providers and relevant authorities. You will meet patients with various degrees of mental illness, providing both independent assessments and collaborative treatment planning.

Qualifications

    Holds an EU-recognized specialist certification in psychiatry
    Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
    Experience in outpatient psychiatry, addiction medicine, or insurance medicine is an advantage
    Strong communication and collaboration skills
    Confident, responsible, and professional approach
    Driver’s license (Category B) required

We are looking for someone who is committed to quality and teamwork, values a supportive environment, and is motivated by contributing to the development of modern psychiatric care.

Living and working in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, a well-functioning healthcare system, and a safe, family-friendly environment. Here, you can enjoy a healthy work-life balance, with time for nature, sports, and leisure. If you dream of a calmer pace of life, clean air, and easy access to forests, lakes, and outdoor activities – Sweden is the perfect place for you.

Benefits with Dignus Medical:

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment.
    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required.
    Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family.
    Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype.

Interested?

Contact me to learn more about the position, the recruitment process, and the relocation support we provide for doctors moving to Sweden. I look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: SAP Business One Consultant - 20080- Remote (Sweden)
description:

With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

title: Account Executive for Ecoroute
description:
Are you driven, business‑oriented, and eager to grow within B2B sales? We are now looking for an Account Executive who will have the opportunity to be part of scaling a new, AI‑driven product within a European software group. You’ll take on a central role in a successful and ambitious team, with strong opportunities to develop and make a real impact. Sounds interesting? Keep on reading!

Movement Software is a Northern European software group focused on niched industry verticals. In our Transport, Logistics & Geodata vertical, Ecoroute/Tetrasoft, Geposit, Postnummerservice, and Dimaps form a strong ecosystem of specialized software companies. Through close collaboration, they deliver complementary solutions that help businesses improve efficiency, gain better control, and navigate an increasingly complex world.

In our companies, we develop data‑driven software solutions that solve real operational challenges for our customers. Our value-adding offering includes address & geodata solutions, geographical management tools, last‑meter delivery planning & production systems and route optimization & delivery execution platforms. Our customers are mainly within transportation, logistics, and field services – but we also help companies in other industries as well.

With our newly developed next-generation platform, Ecoroute, we are redefining how companies plan, optimize and execute their daily transportation operations. From route optimization to real-time execution, we help our customers reduce costs, improve service levels, and make better decisions every day.

About the role As an Account Executive you will play a key role in driving the growth across Sweden and other Nordic and Northern European countries. You will own the full sales cycle from first contact to signed deal, working closely with decision-makers in transport, logistics, and field service industries. You will collaborate with product and customer teams to ensure a strong fit and high-quality customer experience.

You will be part of an ambitious, high-performance environment where we push each other to improve and win together. The position is based in Malmö, Sweden, located at one of our sister companies to ensure close collaboration to Geopt’s Chief Commercial Officer, who is based in Denmark.

Your responsibilities:

    

Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of potential customers.

    

Lead customer meetings, both digital and in person, an demonstrate the value of our offerings – with particular focus on Ecoroute.

    

Drive negotiations and close new deals.

    

Work closely with your colleagues within the Customer Success and Product teams to ensure successful onboarding and long-term value for the customer.

    

Provide market feedback and insights that shape product and commercial development.

Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who is proactive, ambitious, and results-driven – with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to move deals forward. You will thrive in this role if you have experience with B2B sales, preferably within SaaS. We also believe that you have:

    

A strong set of communication skills and the ability to build trust quickly.

    

A comprehensive and solution‑oriented mindset.

    

Natural authority and execution power, combined with a positive and pragmatic attitude.

    

Hunter mentality.

    

"Grit" – you don't give up, even when the work presents challenges.

    

The ability to communicate fluently in both Swedish and English.

    

A valid driver’s license.

Experience from the transportation or logistics industry is considered a plus, as well as the ability to “speak tech,” such as understanding APIs, integrations, and technical concepts.

Interested? Contact us! Does this sound like a role and environment that would suit you? Apply, connect with us, or share this opportunity with someone you think might be a great fit.

If you have questions, reach out to Linnea Olsson, People Business Partner at Movement Software.

We are a part of Movement Software

Ecoroute is part of Movement Software (formerly Progrits), a Northern European software group consisting of around twenty entrepreneur-led companies across three business areas: Vehicle digital solutions, Transport & logistics, and the public mobility. Since 2023, Movement Software has been part of Axcel, a Nordic private equity firm with a strong focus on the technology sector.

Being part of Movement Software provides us with greater opportunities for growth and development, both as a company and as individuals, while also offering the stability and resources of a larger group.

title: Research Operations Intern
description:
Natural Cycles° is a leading women’s health company that developed the world’s first birth control app, used by millions globally. We are a fast growing startup, and we promote an international working environment filled with smart and ambitious colleagues based in Stockholm, Geneva, New York, and remotely. Our mission is to pioneer women’s health through research and passion, empowering every woman with the knowledge she needs to take charge of her health.

As a Research Operations Intern, you'll provide hands-on support for our research studies. You'll keep things running smoothly day-to-day by troubleshooting devices, keeping inventory in order, and making sure every participant has a good experience from their first email to their last.

This is an entry-level role, ideal if you're early in your career and want to see how hardware trials at Natural Cycles work in practice. You don't need prior experience in clinical research. What matters most is that you're organized, reliable, and enjoy solving practical problems.

You'll work closely with the MAD (Medical Algorithm and Data) team and collaborate with Hardware, Finance, IT, and HR. Research and trials workload fluctuates, so we're looking for someone comfortable switching gears to collaborate with other teams if needed.

Please note that this is a one-year contract role based in the Stockholm area, with a start date in December.

What you will be doing

    

Troubleshoot: help participants solve device and app issues, test devices yourself, and figure out what went wrong when something doesn't work. Forward feedback to stakeholders in a structured and organized manner.

    

Look after devices and inventory: keep track of stock, prepare and ship devices and materials, and keep inventory records accurate and up to date.

    

Support participants by answering questions, scheduling calls when needed, and sending follow-up messages in a clear, professional, and friendly way.

    

Keep track of the details: check that signed documents are collected and stored in accordance with the internal protocol, monitor that participants are sharing data as expected, and flag anything that looks off.

    

Help with onboarding: schedule participants and prepare materials.

    

Run offboarding: guide participants through the end of a study, collect devices and materials, and coordinate with Finance so compensation is paid.

What skills and experience we think you have

You enjoy troubleshooting and have the patience to help people who aren't comfortable with technology.

    

You explain things clearly and simply, both in writing and in conversation.

    

You can juggle several tasks at once without losing track.

    

You stay focused on priorities, even when plans change.

    

You're fully proficient in English, spoken and written.

    

You care about women's health and are curious about research.

    

You're comfortable with flexible scheduling, collaborating with multiple teams, and a varying workload.

    

You're based in the Stockholm area and available to start in December for a one-year contract.

What we offer

    

Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location.

    

Professional development - you will work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in the continuous growth and skill enhancement environment.

    

Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work.

    

Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value.

    

Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development.

Location

Most trial operations happen on-site, so being in the office regularly is essential. That said, when the work allows for occasional remote days, we’re glad to make use of that flexibility.

Sounds interesting?

If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

How to apply

To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.

At Natural Cycles we value diversity and inclusion because we know that teams with people from different backgrounds and experiences are stronger. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Pulveroperatör - Hårdmetall
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vi söker nu en framåtsträvande operatör till vår pulvertillverkning på hårdmetallsfabriken.Här får du en central roll i att säkerställa effektiv produktion, samtidigt som du deltar i ett spännande förändringsarbete. Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt engagerade team och bidra till framtidens hårdmetallsproduktion.



Bli en del av vårt teamVälkommen till pulvertillverkningen inom hårdmetallsfabriken hos Epiroc Drilling Tools. Här blir du en del av ett dedikerat team om tre personer, som tillsammans strävar efter att upprätthålla en högkvalitativ produktion och en trygg arbetsmiljö.



Vi lägger stor vikt vid inkluderande och mångfaldsfrämjande värderingar. Kommunikation, öppenhet, nytänkande och personligt ansvar är centrala delar i vår arbetskultur. Vi stöttar varandra i vårt gemensamma uppdrag – att skapa en säker, hållbar och effektiv produktion med fokus på kvalitet och ständiga förbättringar.



Ditt uppdragSom operatör på pulvertillverkningen har du en viktig roll i produktionen där du ansvarar för drift och omställning av maskiner, operatörsunderhåll och kvalitetskontroller. Rollen innefattar självständigt arbete såväl som i grupp. Vi säkerställer att produkterna levereras med hög kvalitet och i rätt tid. Du identifierar och rapporterar avvikelser, samt bidrar aktivt till att kontinuerligt förbättra arbetsprocesserna tillsammans med ditt team.



Din profilVi söker dig som trivs med att ta ansvar och att driva på förändring. Din nyfikenhet, initiativförmåga och förmåga att strukturera och organisera är egenskaper vi värderar högt. Vi tror också att du trivs med att skapa och bibehålla relationer, och har lätt för att samarbeta effektivt med både ditt team och övriga funktioner inom produktionen och organisationen.



I den här rollen är det viktigt att du kan kommunicera på svenska i både tal och skrift.



Placering och övrigtDenna position är placerad i Fagersta, Sverige.Arbetstiderna är för närvarande förlagda till dagtid.



Livet på Epiroc



När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.



Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:




    Globala karriärmöjligheter.
    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.
    Samhällsengagemang.
    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.



Ansökan och kontakt



Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 28 Oktober 2026. Ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.



Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.



För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta:



Anställande chef: Patricia Olsson, Produktionsledare Hårdmetall, patricia.olsson@epiroc.com



Rekryteringsspecialist: Susanne Kjellman, susanne.kjellman@external.epiroc.com

title: Kvantitativ konsult Quantitative Intelligence | Stockholm

title: Control Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking to expand our Swedish engineering team with a junior software / control systems engineer who is motivated to grow into a complex and specialized technical environment.

The role is focused on control systems for our waterjets, where software, PLCs, and HMIs interact closely with mechanical and hydraulic systems. You will work alongside experienced engineers and gradually take on more responsibility as your understanding of the systems grows.

Today, our systems are primarily based on PLC and HMI platforms, but we are currently developing our next-generation control system, which will be PC-based, running Linux, with Qt-based displays. This provides an opportunity to work with both established technologies and modern software platforms.

This position is well suited for someone early in their career who is curious, structured, and eager to learn how real-world control systems are built, maintained, and supported over long lifecycles.

Key responsibilities

    Support development, maintenance, and troubleshooting of control software for industrial and marine systems.
    Work with PLC-based control systems, learning to read, understand, and modify existing code.
    Assist with configuration and development of HMI applications used in operational systems.
    Participate in testing and validation using development and simulation environments.
    Support investigation of field issues together with senior engineers.
    Collaborate with colleagues in Sweden and support internal teams when needed.
    Be part of the development of our next-generation control system.

Required qualifications

    A degree in software engineering, automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, or a related field.
    Basic understanding of programming concepts and structured code.
    Interest in industrial control systems, automation, or embedded/real-time software.
    Willingness to work with existing systems and learn from legacy codebases.
    Ability to work in a structured and careful manner, especially in environments where reliability is critical.
    Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Preferred (but not required)

    Exposure to PLC programming (e.g. CODESYS or similar).
    Basic knowledge of industrial automation or control theory.
    Experience from internships, thesis work, or projects related to automation or embedded systems.
    Interest in systems that combine software, hardware, mechanics, and hydraulics.

Personal qualities

For this role, attitude and mindset are more important than specific tools. We are looking for someone who:

    Is curious and motivated to learn.
    Is patient and methodical when working with complex systems.
    Is comfortable asking questions and learning from more experienced colleagues.
    Takes responsibility and follows tasks through to completion.
    Enjoys understanding how systems work, not only writing new code.

What we offer

    The opportunity to develop deep competence in a specialized technical domain.
    A long-term role in a stable engineering environment in Sweden.
    Exposure to real-world systems with long lifecycles and high technical requirements.
    Opportunities to travel, as our customers are located around the globe.



The position is based at our head office in Uppsala and it is full time.

title: Applied Machine Learning Lead
description:
Position Overview

The Applied Machine Learning Lead is a senior, hands-on role responsible for ensuring Data Science and Machine Learning initiatives deliver measurable business value. The role combines product ownership, roadmap management, advanced analytics, production-ready machine learning engineering, experimentation ownership, technical standards, and deep iGaming expertise. The focus is on identifying high-value opportunities, prioritising initiatives, delivering robust and scalable data science solutions, evaluating outcomes, and driving adoption of data-driven decision-making across the business.

Success in this role is measured not only by model performance, but by the impact those models have on player behaviour, commercial outcomes, product performance, and the ability of the Data Science function to deliver reliable, reusable, and scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

    Lead and perform advanced commercial and business-focused analyses to support strategic decision-making.
    Design, build, deploy, and maintain production-grade statistical and machine learning models, applying software engineering best practices to improve maintainability, reliability, testing, observability, and speed from experimentation to production.
    Own the end-to-end experimentation lifecycle, from hypothesis definition and experiment design through implementation, validation, analysis, interpretation, and iterative optimisation.
    Ensure analytical recommendations and model outcomes are grounded in statistically sound methods and commercially meaningful results.
    Review, validate, and challenge analytical work, experiments, and machine learning models to ensure technical correctness, robustness, scalability, and business relevance.
    Own and manage the data science backlog and roadmap, prioritising work in collaboration with stakeholders
    Translate complex business problems into well-scoped initiatives with clear objectives, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.
    Provide technical leadership on modelling approaches, feature engineering, validation methods, experimentation design, deployment practices, and continuous improvement of machine learning solutions
    Develop reusable machine learning capabilities, analytical workflows, and technical standards to improve quality, consistency, scalability, and efficiency across the Data Science function.
    Establish and promote standards for model review, documentation, feature engineering, validation, testing, monitoring, and production readiness.
    Drive continuous improvement of the machine learning platform and team practices, including MLOps, AI-assisted development, automation, engineering productivity, and modern ways of building and operating ML systems.
    Support and ensure adherence to governance, lifecycle management, and relevant policies and processes.
    Monitor model performance, data drift, and impact; ensure appropriate retraining and continuous improvement.
    Lead and manage the Data Science team, including coaching, feedback, performance discussions, and day-to-day prioritisation.
    Collaborate closely with product, developers, and commercial teams to deliver data-driven solutions end-to-end
    Communicate insights, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Requirements

    Extensive experience in applied data science, analytics, and machine learning.
    Strong proficiency in Python.
    Solid understanding of statistical modelling, predictive analytics,
    experimentation, hypothesis testing, causal reasoning, and model validation.
    Experience designing, analysing, and interpreting experiments such as AB tests.
    Experience working with SQL and large-scale datasets (e.g. in Databricks / Spark environments).
    xperience designing, deploying, maintaining, or reviewing models in production or business-critical workflows.
    Practical understanding of software engineering best practices relevant to machine learning, including testing, version control, code review, documentation, monitoring, and maintainability.
    Experience with MLOps concepts and practices, including model lifecycle management, monitoring, retraining, deployment workflows, and production readiness.
    Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
    Proven experience leading or mentoring data scientists in a professional setting.
    Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, analytics, commercial, or operational teams to deliver measurable outcomes.
    Experience in iGaming, gaming, e-commerce, fintech, or another high-volume digital product environment.Strong analytical judgement and structured problem-solving ability.
    Confident technical leader with the ability to challenge, guide, and improve others’ work.
    Strong understanding of how to build reliable, maintainable, and production- ready machine learning solutions, not just experimental models
    Clear, concise communicator able to influence both technical and non- technical stakeholders.
    Comfortable making prioritisation decisions in environments with competing demands and incomplete information

The above duties provide a generic description of the Employee’s day to day responsibilities but should in no way be deemed to be an exhaustive list. Additional related, duties may be assigned by the Line Manager in line with business exigencies and continuity.

Why Work With Us?

At Silverspin, we take bold but thoughtful approaches to what we build and how we work. We act with confidence and responsibility, focusing on smart decisions, meaningful impact, and long-term success.

Joining us means being part of a team that values curiosity, ownership, and collaboration. We encourage people to challenge ideas, simplify complexity, and grow together - creating an environment where great work (and good energy) go hand in hand.

We offer:

    Competitive salary and benefits
    Opportunities to learn, grow, and develop
    A creative, collaborative team environment

Silverspin is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Geodata Specialist
description:
Exploration Geodata Specialist for Boliden Mines

Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society’s access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future. What matters is how we produce them. Become part of us and drive change for generations to come.

Your opportunity

Would you like to combine geoscience, data and technology to support the future of mineral exploration?

We are looking for an Exploration Geodata Specialist to help develop and maintain Boliden’s geoscientific data platform and support exploration teams across the organization. You will help ensure that Boliden’s geoscientific and exploration data remains reliable, accessible and useful over time. A key part of the assignment will be contributing to the implementation and further development of our new SQL-based geodata platform, QDB, across our exploration sites.

The position can be based at the Boliden office or at one of our sites, subject to agreement.

Who you will work with

You will be part of our Exploration Geodata team and collaborate with database geologists, geologists, geophysicists, GIS users, mine geologists, Boliden IT, the Assay & Data Quality group and Exploration management. You will also interact with software suppliers, consultants, developers and other technology partners.

This is a collaborative role where you will connect operational geoscience needs with practical and sustainable technical solutions.

What you will do

Your main responsibilities will include:

    Develop, improve and document SQL-based exploration database structures, views and validation logic
    Design workflows for geological, geophysical and spatial data
    Support the rollout and continued development of QDB
    Develop SQL scripts, import and export routines and automated workflows
    Integrate databases with GIS, modelling, reporting and analysis tools
    Support data quality, governance, QA/QC, metadata management and controlled access
    Translate the needs of geologists, geophysicists and Geodata users into practical system improvements
    Test new solutions and provide technical support, documentation and training material
    Collaborate with Geodata, Exploration, GIS users, IT and external suppliers
    Help ensure that exploration data is reliable, validated, traceable and accessible over time

What you bring

You enjoy working at the intersection of geoscience and technology. You approach complex information methodically and understand the importance of quality, traceability and long-term maintainability. You communicate clearly and can turn operational needs into practical technical solutions.

We believe you have

    A university degree or equivalent education in geology, geophysics, GIS, geodata management, database development, computer science or another relevant technical field
    Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases
    A good understanding of geological or geophysical data, drillhole data and exploration workflows
    Practical experience with GIS and spatial data
    Programming or scripting skills
    The ability to develop, test and document database applications and automated workflows
    A structured, quality-focused and analytical approach
    Good written and spoken English
    Proficiency in the local language relevant to your workplace
    The ability to collaborate effectively with both technical specialists and operational users
    A valid European Category B driver’s license

It is an advantage if you have

    Experience integrating databases with GIS or geological modelling tools
    Experience with geodata management, exploration databases or geological and geophysical information
    Broad academic or professional experience covering both geoscience and data systems

We value potential and encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

Why work with us

At Boliden, care, courage and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a collaborative workplace where your contribution can have a direct impact on future generations. You will have the opportunity to work with geoscientific information that supports exploration activities across Boliden and to shape systems and workflows designed for long-term value.

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us remain at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. We therefore encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.

Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager Monica Johansson, monica.johansson@boliden.com, +46 70 201 21 67.

Questions about the application are answered by our Talent Acquisition Partner, Terese Lindholm, terese.lindholm@boliden.com.

For union information, please contact Mats Lindblom, SACO, +46 73-350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70-541 83 93 or Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910-77 40 09.

title: Co-Founder / CEO - Hybrid/Remote
description:
Co-Founder / CEO – Build the Next Big Tech Company

Start from day one – with capital, customers, and a team behind you

Company Description

This isn’t your typical company – we launch one new tech venture every month.

We develop the idea, validate customer demand, secure funding, and build the initial infrastructure – then we bring in a founder like you to step in as the CEO & co-founder from day one.

You won’t be starting alone. You’ll be building something new, bold, and scalable – but with a team of experienced operators, proven processes, and startup capital behind you.

Our team has founded and scaled companies like Realforce (120+ M ARR) and Minna Technologies (770M exit to Mastercard). Now we’re doing it again – over and over – and we’re looking for founders to build with us.

Our Model

What we provide:

A validated business idea and early customer interest

Startup capital and a full operational support team (tech, finance, legal, growth)

You as CEO & co-founder with equity from day one

A proven framework that creates profitable companies fast

Our Background & Track Record

We’ve launched multiple ventures already, and several became profitable within 12 months.

We select one founder per month to build with – and fully commit our resources to that venture.

This is not an accelerator, incubator, or passive investment – it’s co-building from scratch.

Our Team & Culture

We’re builders – not theorists.

We value speed, ownership, and clarity. Our studio is structured for execution, and we only work with people who have the grit and vision to drive something forward – fast.

You’ll work alongside operators in tech, design, GTM, legal and fundraising – and have the space to make the CEO role your own.

Requirement Profile – Who We're Looking For

We only work with three founder personas. Do you recognize yourself in one of them?

Founder Personas

1. The Growth Hacker

Commercially driven and thrives in sales and GTM

Built sales machines, funnels, teams or grown revenue 0–20M+

Ready to lead and build from scratch – with strong operational support

2. The Ex-Consultant

Background at McKinsey, BCG, Bain or similar

Wants to own a P&L, not just analyze it

Gets things done even in messy, imperfect conditions

Ready to lead a company, not just build decks

3. The Tech Builder

Senior developer or product builder who’s shipped real V1s

Can turn ideas into MVPs in weeks – not months

Has “unshakable conviction” about their ability to solve hard problems

Wants to be CEO and get commercial help from day one

Role Responsibilities

    Step in as CEO & co-founder of a new company
    Lead product development, GTM, hiring and growth
    Work directly with our team for support in sales, marketing, operations, finance, tech and legal
    Build and scale a business from 0 to funding, profitability, or beyond

Your Day-to-Day

    Operate as CEO of a brand-new venture
    Work closely with customers to validate and refine the product
    Collaborate with the team + other portfolio companies to execute and scale
    Recruit early team members
    Set goals and drive traction – fast

Qualifications & Experience

    You’ve built something before – a product, a sales pipeline, a company, or a team
    You’re comfortable with ambiguity and quick decision-making
    You have strong leadership instincts and can own your work
    You match one of our founder personas (Growth, Consulting, Tech)
    You have high “GSDQ” – Get Shit Done Quotient

Traits & Characteristics

    Entrepreneurial mindset
    Action-oriented and strategic thinker
    Clear communicator and team leader
    Quick learner with a hunger for building
    You don’t want a job – you want ownership

Career Growth & Benefits

    30% Equity as co-founder from day one
    Support from a full operational team
    Network, partners and potential investors provided
    High-impact role with startup-level freedom and real backing
    Proven model with real success stories



Compensation: 0 SEK base salary. Salary negotiated within 6 months. 30% equity as Co-Founder from day one.

title: IT Support for Cibes Lift Group
description:
Hey there! Ready to dive into the world of IT support? Kickstart your IT career as IT Support at Cibes Lift Group!
