Your mission? Providing technical assistance to clients and internal users, whether it's face-to-face, over the phone, or through remote tools. You'll be our go-to support expert, solving problems, diagnosing issues, and using your technical curiosity and skills to save the day.

You'll also be the go-to person for software and hardware support, handling password resets, managing user accounts, and contributing to our IT security initiatives and policies. Here's the kicker: you'll never be bored. With our ever-evolving operations, your role will constantly adapt, giving you the opportunity to take on new challenges and explore new technologies. And remember, you won't be doing it alone. You'll be part of a team of three IT Support professionals who work closely together to support both each other and the business.

So, who are we looking for? You're the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same. You know your way around Windows systems, and when it comes to communication, you'll need to be comfortable communicating in both English and Swedish, whether you're chatting face-to-face or shooting off an email. You'll also need to hold a permanent work permit in Sweden to be considered for this position.

But it's not just about technical skills. We're looking for someone who is structured, a great team player, and patient when it comes to troubleshooting. You genuinely enjoy helping people, and nothing is more rewarding than finding the solution that makes someone's day a little easier.

Sound like you? If you're ready to roll up your sleeves, take on new challenges, and be part of an awesome team, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and let's make some IT magic happen together!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Do you want to build modern software for critical logistics and transportation processes, and follow the customer all the way from need to result?

At IMI, we deliver SaaS-based solutions that support warehousing, transportation management, delivery visibility, and checkout experiences, used every day by leading retailers and logistics providers.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands the customer’s world, can turn needs into precise requirements, and takes responsibility for what ships. You will work the way modern teams do, with AI as a natural part of how software gets built.

About the Role

You will be a natural part of the customer’s whole journey, from onboarding new customers to supporting and maintaining existing ones. Most of your time will be spent designing, developing, and improving our products and integrations, while also supporting customers and colleagues when technical expertise is needed.

Unlike a traditional in-house development role, you will work directly with customers, particularly within integrations and technical onboarding in real-world logistics operations. You will work on new functionality, integrations, technical improvements, troubleshooting, and the continuous development of our solutions, in a cross-functional team with software engineers, architects, business consultants, and project managers.

You will work with modern SaaS platforms, cloud-native services, distributed integrations, and business-critical systems that process large volumes of transactions every day. Our solutions are built on technologies including .NET, C#, SQL, TypeScript, Azure, and modern web frameworks, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, maintainability, and continuous delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

    Translate customer and business needs into clear, testable specifications
    Design and develop new functionality and integrations between customer systems and our solutions, using AI tools and agents as part of your daily work, and own the quality of the result
    Develop and maintain business-critical software solutions, and troubleshoot issues in production together with customers and colleagues
    Assess business value, risk, and impact before and after changes
    Take part in customer onboarding, support, and maintenance as a technical specialist
    Contribute to product improvements, roadmap initiatives, and technical enhancements

Your Profile

We believe you enjoy combining software development with a customer-focused mindset. You are curious, collaborative, and motivated by solving technical challenges. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable working independently, and are proactive in improving products, processes, and ways of working.

You can turn what you learn from customers into requirements that you or others can build and test against, and you balance business value, risk, and effort with long-term sustainability. You know what good looks like, and you can tell when code is not it, including code you did not write yourself. You are not afraid to ask for help when needed and appreciate knowledge sharing within a team environment.

We Believe You Have:

    A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
    Strong ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable technical requirements
    The ability to read, understand, and judge code, particularly in our stack (.NET, C#, SQL, TypeScript), including code you did not write yourself
    Practical experience developing with AI tools and agents, and a good sense of where they help and where they fail
    Several years of professional software development experience, including making independent technical decisions regarding architecture, quality, and risk
    The ability to get up to speed quickly in a complex domain
    Experience with integration development and customer-facing technical roles within a service-oriented organization
    Experience with cloud platforms and modern architectural patterns
    Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English

Preferred Qualifications:

    Experience with supply chain, logistics, transportation management, or warehouse management solutions
    Experience from a software product company
    Experience with Vue.js and Azure DevOps

The position is primarily based in Linköping and offers a hybrid working model.

Why IMI?

IMI Supply Chain Solutions is a leading software provider specializing in sustainable logistics and order management. Our solutions are at the core of critical industries such as grocery retail and pharmaceutical supply chains. We are in an exciting phase of growth, offering you the opportunity to influence both our products and the way we work with product development going forward.

We are proud to be Great Place To Work certified and offer a workplace with a strong sense of team spirit, a high degree of autonomy, and excellent opportunities for professional development. In addition, we provide a generous benefits package, including extra vacation days, a wellness allowance, and occupational pension contributions.

Application

Is this the right role for you? We warmly welcome your application. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR Business Partner, Ebba Olofsson, at ebba.olofsson@im.se

title: Industrail Engineer
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Role Summary

As an Industrial Engineer, you will play a key role in a smaller production unit where your work has a direct impact on our business. With short decision-making paths, your ideas can quickly become tangible improvements.

You will be an important part of our production engineering development, with the opportunity to take ideas and analyses all the way through to implemented solutions that make a measurable difference. The role offers a high degree of ownership and the opportunity to influence our technology, ways of working and business results. You will work closely with production, maintenance and external suppliers, playing a central role in ensuring robust, efficient and future-proof technical solutions.

We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and levels of experience—whether you are at the beginning of your career or bring several years of industry experience.

Job Responsibilities

As a Industrial Engineer, you will be an important part of the bigger picture working closely with our assembly operations. You will provide technical support and help resolve day-to-day production-related questions and challenges as well as responsibility for the procurement and replacement of equipment.

Your responsibilities include:

    Solving problems cross-functionally together with relevant stakeholders, including production, quality, logistics, maintenance, engineering and IT
    Procuring and installing new equipment, as well as modifying existing equipment
    Challenging and adapting production processes to support the introduction of new or modified products
    Leading and delivering improvement projects related to our production processes
    Identifying opportunities for improvement, supporting the justification of new investments and contributing to continuous development
    Providing technical support to production in daily operations

Who You Are

We believe you are someone who enjoys working in a structured production environment, gains energy from cross-functional collaboration and is motivated by achieving results.

You likely have:

    A university degree in engineering or equivalent experience, preferably within industrial, mechanical or electrical engineering
    A strong technical interest; experience in production engineering is an advantage
    Experience leading or contributing to projects
    An interest in IT-related solutions
    Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

To succeed in this role, you:

    Are solution-oriented and enjoy taking on technical challenges
    Show drive, initiative and a genuine desire to make a difference
    Thrive in a cross-functional environment and build strong working relationships
    Take ownership and deliver high-quality results
    Work in a structured and analytical way, with a focus on continuous improvement
    Communicate clearly and contribute to a positive and collaborative culture

Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-24. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

Are you a board-certified radiologist looking for a new challenge in a beautiful part of Sweden?

This position combines professional development with a high quality of life in a scenic region known for its lakes, forests and outdoor lifestyle.

About the hospital and department

The radiology department is part of the Diagnostic Imaging and Functional Medicine division and performs around 24,000 examinations annually. The unit is equipped with two ultrasound machines, one MRI, one CT scanner and two conventional X-ray systems (one with fluoroscopy). Both acute and planned diagnostic services are provided in modern facilities with continuously updated technology.

You will join a skilled and stable team of radiologists, radiographers, nurses and administrative staff. Staff turnover among doctors has been close to zero in recent years. The department is also preparing for a major upgrade of both premises and equipment in the near future.

Tasks and responsibilities

    Broad diagnostic radiology including conventional X-ray, ultrasound and CT.
    Participation in both acute and planned care.
    Collaboration with other clinical specialties.
    On-call duties are possible but not mandatory (primarily organised from a nearby hospital).

Requirements

    Specialist certification in radiology from an EU/EEA country, recognised by EU directive 2005/36/EC.
    Several years of clinical experience preferred, but not mandatory.
    Skills in ultrasound and CT required; fluoroscopy and interventional procedures are a plus.
    Good command of English. Willingness to learn Swedish to minimum B2/C1 level (language training provided).

Personal profile

    Cooperative and a team player, while able to work independently.
    Flexible and adaptable in a changing clinical environment.
    Service-minded and attentive in patient interaction.
    Proactive and quality-focused.

Terms and conditions

    Full-time, Monday–Friday, daytime hours.
    Competitive salary
    Permanent employment in the Swedish public healthcare system.
    Relocation package and intensive Swedish language training included.

Why this location?

The hospital is located in the heart of Hälsingland, a region offering a unique combination of professional challenges and an exceptional quality of life. Here you will find affordable housing, short commutes, and endless opportunities for outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing, and fishing – all within reach of a modern healthcare environment.

Application process

Please send a complete application including:

    CV and cover letter
    Diplomas and specialist certificate
    Employment references
    Information on your availability to start language training and relocation

EU/EEA candidates only. Swedish medical license and specialist recognition from the National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen) are required before independent practice. Support will be provided throughout this process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: SAP Solution Architect
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Is the feeling of having a meaningful job something you like? Would you like to share your thoughts and knowledge to enable growth and profitability? Do you want tho work with ERP services globally? Then this just might be the right challenge for you as we are looking for new team members to our SAP SAP team.



We have a multi ERP strategy within Epiroc and one of our global managed ERP applications is SAP. Our current SAP installation consist of 4 different SAP ERP solutions that is used by 20 customer centers and 2 productions centers. We have started the cloud journey of upgrade one of our installations for the customer center to the SAP S4HANA. The upgrade will let our business to be able to utilise the latest functionality provided from the SAP application. We are therefore looking for strengthening the team with SAP Solution Architect.



We work in an open and friendly way, where we support each other to ensure we provide the best possible solutions for our users. We complement each other with a broad knowledge, and we make sure to have fun at work. Within Epiroc IT so have we started the transformation to an agile working model.  



Your Mission



As SAP Solution Architect, you will design and govern SAP solutions that align with business strategy while ensuring scalable, future-proof architecture.



You will translate business requirements into SAP functional and technical designs.



Ensure integration across SAP modules and surrounding systems.



Standardization and template based delivery is important factors for the SAP environment.



You should be updated on new technology and functionality that can improve the solution.

Profile description:

Your profileYou have an experience within SAP ERP Solutions.



You have a University Degree or similar knowledge gained through work experience. Experience with leading teams is beneficial.  



You have more than 4 years of experience within an IT area in an international company.



As for your personal skills we are looking for someone who is goal orientated, fast learner and eager to learn along the way.



You are able to adopt new technologies and tools when needed, open-minded to enjoy intellectual sparring and knowledge sharing.



The job requires a lot of collaboration both internally and externally so good interpersonal and communications skills are a prerequisite to be successful in the role.



We also expect you to have good analytical and administration skills. Location and travel



The location is preferable at one of our Epiroc IT hubs, located in Örebro or Stockholm, (Sweden), Prague, (Czech Republic).  



International travel will be part of the role.



Application and contactsIn this recruitment process we review applications continuously and we may close the process before the last application day.







A hybrid workplace



Life at Epiroc can include the possibility for a hybrid workplace. It is a way of working that offers flexibility and participation allowing for a better balance between work and private life, which also promotes well-being.



At the same time, we value in-person collaboration and team connection. Therefore, we expect our employees to be present in the office at least three days per week, with flexibility for remote work during the remaining working days, depending on business needs and role requirements.

title: Global Talent, People Analytics and Data Management Manager
description:
Role Summary

The purpose of the role is to lead the global Talent, People Analytics and Data Management agenda within Production, Procurement and Logistics (PPL), ensuring that people, capability and workforce decisions are supported by robust processes, high-quality data and actionable insights.

The role enables sustainable business performance and transformation by strengthening talent and leadership pipelines, supporting succession and development, and transforming people data into insights that guide strategic workforce decisions.

Acting as a key bridge between the PPL business, Group P&C and the global CoE structure, the role ensures that business needs are translated into relevant global processes, data requirements and solutions. The role also drives alignment, governance and continuous improvement across the PPL Process Manager network and supports effective implementation and adoption across countries and business units

Job Responsibilities

    Lead PPL’s global talent and succession agenda, ensuring strong leadership pipelines, talent pools and development planning for critical roles and future capabilities.
    Transform people data into actionable insights, ensure data quality and governance, and support the effective use and development of SAP MySuccess, Power BI and related HR systems.
    Lead and harmonize global P&C processes, translate business needs into scalable solutions, and drive continuous improvement, automation and process effectiveness across PPL.
    Coordinate global implementation.
    Facilitate Process Manager and CoE networks, and provide validated reporting and performance insights to PPL Management.
    Build strong relationships across PPL, Group P&C, CoEs, HRBPs and local organizations, representing business needs and promoting knowledge sharing and data-driven decision-making.

Who You Are

    10+ years of experience in People & Culture, preferably in Talent Management, People Analytics, HR Data Management, Project Management, Process Management, or related areas.
    University degree in HR, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
    Proven track record of working globally across functions in complex matrix organizations, including process and system implementation.
    Experience designing and managing learning & development, performance, and succession processes, including governance, reporting, compliance, and user adoption.
    Strong project management experience delivering global and cross-functional P&C initiatives.
    Experience leading P&C processes and driving automation (e.g., Power Automate) and continuous improvement.
    Strong background in HR systems and people analytics, preferably SAP SuccessFactors/MySuccess and Power BI.
    Experience in talent management, succession planning, leadership development, learning, and strategic workforce planning.
    Excellent stakeholder management skills with senior leaders, CoEs, P&C teams, and business functions.
    Experience in Production, Procurement & Logistics or another global operational environment is an advantage.

This Is Us

You will join Scania’s PPL People & Culture community and work in a cross-functional environment with colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation. The role connects global P&C process development with business needs and people insights, collaborating with process owners, P&C colleagues, managers and data/analytics stakeholders. Together, we develop simple, consistent and value-creating ways of working that support Scania’s people and business priorities.

Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-23. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:

Jens Åklinder Lagerström, Head of People & Culture Powertrain, jens.aklinder.lagerstrom@scania.com

We look forward to your application!

Senior IT Systems \& Network Administrator
==========================================

Position Summary
----------------

We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on IT professional to take operational ownership of the school's day\-to\-day IT environment.

This is a senior, campus\- based technical position combining systems administration, enterprise networking and high\-quality user support.

The successful candidate will independently diagnose and resolve complex incidents, maintain the reliability of core IT services and anticipate issues before they disrupt teaching and learning.

They will serve as a key on\-site IT contact for staff and work closely with Regional and Global IT teams, following Group technical standards, security policies and change\-management procedures.

The role requires sound technical judgement, clear communication and the ability to plan, prioritise and

deliver work with limited day\-to\-day supervision. It is a hands\-on position rather than a people\-management role.



Key Responsibilities

**Campus IT Operations \& Technical Ownership**

* Take day\-to\-day ownership of campus IT operations, from incident triage and diagnosis through resolution, documentation and follow\-up.
* Independently prioritise support requests and operational tasks, with particular urgency for incidents affecting lessons, examinations and essential school services.
* Proactively monitor recurring issues, service health and technology risks; recommend and implement practical improvements within delegated authority.
* Act as the senior on\-site technical contact, coordinating with school stakeholders, IT colleagues and external suppliers; escalate significant incidents with clear technical evidence and business impact.


**Systems, Microsoft 365 \& Identity Management**

* Administer Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID, including users, groups, licences, role\-appropriate access permissions, authentication and account lifecycle processes.
* Operate and troubleshoot Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online, including mailboxes, collaboration services and access\-related incidents.
* Support secure identity practices, including MFA, access controls and the implementation of centrally defined security policies.
* Investigate service degradation, authentication failures and device\-to\-cloud integration issues, identifying root causes and implementing controlled fixes.


**Endpoint \& Device Management**

* Administer Windows endpoints through Microsoft Intune, including enrolment, device configuration, application deployment, policy application and troubleshooting.
* Support Apple Macs and iPads through Jamf and maintain compliant, reliable device configurations in accordance with Group standards.
* Manage provisioning, deployment, replacement, patching and end\-of\-life processes for staff and shared school devices.


**Networking \& Infrastructure**

* Provide hands\-on operation and advanced troubleshooting of the campus wired and wireless network, including switches, access points, network connectivity and related services.
* Use Cisco Meraki management and diagnostic tools, where authorised, to investigate client connectivity, switch ports, Wi\-Fi performance and infrastructure alerts.
* Diagnose issues involving TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, switching, routing fundamentals, wireless authentication and Internet connectivity; distinguish endpoint, local\-network and upstream service faults.
* Carry out approved network changes, equipment replacements and site deployments in coordination with Regional or Global IT; maintain accurate configurations and documentation.
* Work with connectivity and network service providers to restore service and prevent repeat incidents.


**User Support \& Classroom Technology**

* Provide second\-line and senior escalation support for complex Windows, Microsoft 365, endpoint, classroom AV/interactive display and peripheral issues, while remaining responsive to urgent day\-to\-day support needs.
* Help teachers and staff use school technology effectively; communicate incident status and practical workarounds in accessible, non\-technical language.
* Support PaperCut MF / Find\-Me printing and cloud telephony, coordinating specialist suppliers where required.


**Security, Documentation \& Projects**

* Maintain IT asset records, operational procedures, technical documentation and useful knowledge\-base articles.
* Contribute to refresh programmes, upgrades, onboarding/offboarding and continuous improvement projects, managing assigned on\-site activities autonomously.
* Apply information\-security, privacy and safeguarding requirements; identify and promptly escalate security incidents or risks in line with established procedures.




**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Typically 5\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience in IT support, systems administration or network operations, including demonstrable responsibility for independently managing a business or campus IT environment. Equivalent experience will be considered.
* Strong practical experience administering Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID, including identity/access management and troubleshooting Exchange Online services.
* Hands\-on experience with Windows device management using Microsoft Intune, including configuration and deployment workflows.
* Solid enterprise networking knowledge and evidence of resolving real\-world issues involving TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, switching, Wi\-Fi and network access.
* Proven ability to investigate and resolve incidents end\-to\-end, identify root causes, assess service impact and escalate efficiently when an issue exceeds the role's authority or scope.
* Ability to work independently on\-site, organise competing priorities, communicate clearly with non\-technical users and coordinate vendors and remote technical teams.
* Professional working proficiency in English (at least B2; C1 preferred).


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**

* Hands\-on administration or support of Cisco Meraki switches, wireless access points and security appliances.
* Experience using Jamf School or Jamf Pro to manage Apple Macs and iPads.
* Experience with MFA, Microsoft Conditional Access, endpoint security, PowerShell or practical IT automation.
* Familiarity with PaperCut MF, Find\-Me printing and cloud\-based VoIP services.
* Previous experience in international education or another multi\-user, service\-critical environment.
* Relevant Microsoft or networking certifications (e.g., Microsoft 365/Endpoint Administrator or CCNA), or equivalent proven expertise.
* French proficiency (B1 or above preferred; B2 a strong advantage).




**Safeguarding \& Professional Conduct**

The successful candidate must uphold the school's commitments to safeguarding and the welfare of children and young people, protect confidential information, and follow applicable data protection and information\-security policies. Appointment is subject to the relevant pre\-employment checks and applicable Swiss legal requirements.

education. \* Maintain competence in emergency response, first aid, medication administration, and relevant clinical procedures. ### Clinical Nursing Care \* Provide nursing care to students, staff, and visitors during scheduled shifts. \* Assess and manage acute and chronic illnesses, injuries, and health conditions. \* Conduct nursing assessments and develop appropriate care plans. \* Monitor students' health and recognise signs of deterioration requiring escalation or referral. \* Provide first aid and emergency care in accordance with relevant Swiss and Croix\\-Rouge standards. \* Refer students to doctors, hospitals, emergency services, or other healthcare professionals when clinically appropriate. \* Administer prescribed medications and treatments safely and maintain accurate medication records. \* Support vaccination programmes and infection prevention and control procedures in accordance with applicable Swiss guidance. \* Provide health advice and appropriate emotional support to students. \* Maintain accurate and contemporaneous electronic medical records. ### On Call and Overnight Nursing \* Remain on call and available throughout the scheduled shift to respond to student health needs. \* Respond promptly to urgent and unexpected illnesses, injuries, and medical concerns. \* Provide overnight nursing care and observation to unwell students. \* Monitor students in the Health Centre and, when required, coordinate care with boarding/house staff. \* Escalate concerns appropriately to senior clinical staff, parents, doctors, emergency services, or other healthcare professionals. \* Provide clear and accurate clinical handovers to ensure continuity of care. \* Maintain calm, professional decision\\-making during urgent and potentially stressful situations. ### Individual Student Care \* Develop and maintain individual health and care plans in collaboration with students, parents, house staff, wellbeing teams, and external healthcare professionals. \* Consider students' capacity to consent to treatment in accordance with applicable professional and legal requirements. \* Communicate with parents/guardians regarding significant illness, injury, treatment, and follow\\-up while respecting confidentiality. \* Support students with ongoing medical, physical, emotional, and wellbeing needs. \* Promote student independence and encourage appropriate self\\-management of health conditions. ### Safeguarding and Child Protection \* Actively promote and follow the school's Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy. \* Maintain awareness of indicators of abuse, neglect, exploitation, and other safeguarding concerns. \* Record safeguarding concerns accurately, objectively, and promptly. \* Report concerns immediately through Chef/in Strategie und Governance Verteidigung
=============================================







**Bern (und Homeoffice) \| 80\-100% \|**



  **Diesen Beitrag können Sie leisten**







* Dem Chef der Armee und der Armeeführung die strategische Steuerung der langfristigen Entwicklung der Gruppe Verteidigung ermöglichen. Den Chef Strategie, Steuerung und Transformation bei dessen/deren Abwesenheit in allen Belangen vertreten
* Entscheidungsgrundlagen zur Weiterentwicklung der Gruppe V in den Bereichen Strategie, Organisationsentwicklung und Transformation verantworten
* Die Organisationsentwicklung der Gruppe Verteidigung koordinieren und deren Kohärenz mit der strategischen Ausrichtung sicherstellen
* Die Governance der Gruppe Verteidigung strategieorientiert weiterentwickeln und verankern
* Ein erfahrenes Team führen sowie interdisziplinäre Arbeitsgruppen mit Experten und Stakeholdern auf oberster Führungsebene koordinieren
* Das Senior Management bei der Entwicklung, Abstimmung und Umsetzung von Teil\- und Fachstrategien unterstützen und beraten


  **Das macht Sie einzigartig**







* Hochschul\- oder Fachhochschulabschluss oder gleichwertige Ausbildung
* Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie vernetztes und strategisches Denkvermögen
* Langjährige Erfahrung Strategie, Organisationsentwicklung oder Transformation, idealerweise entlang des gesamten Strategiezyklus – von Analyse und Planung über Alignment bis Umsetzung und Controlling
* Ausgeprägte Beratungskompetenz und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Stakeholder\-Landschaften mit teilweise divergierenden Interessen wirkungsvoll zu navigieren
* Kenntnisse der bundesinternen Prozesse und Strukturen oder eine Ausbildung zum Generalstabs\- bzw. Stabsoffizier sind von Vorteil
* Sehr gute aktive Kenntnisse in mindestens einer zweiten Amtssprache (B2\) sowie Englisch mindestens B2


  **Auf den Punkt gebracht**



Das Team Strategie und Governance V gestaltet die langfristige Ausrichtung der Gruppe V zur Stärkung der Verteidigungsfähigkeit der Schweiz. Wir schaffen strategische Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Chef der Armee und die Armeeführung und unterstützen sie dabei, die Entwicklung der Gruppe als Ganzes zu steuern. Unser Anspruch ist es, Strategie in organisationale Wirkung zu übersetzen – durch klare Prioritäten, kohärente Governance und konsequente Umsetzung.  

Als Chef des Teams verantwortest du zentrale strategische Fragestellungen an der Schnittstelle von militärischer und organisationaler Entwicklung. Du berätst das Senior Management, koordinierst organisationsübergreifende Vorhaben und stellst die Kohärenz der Organisationsentwicklung sicher. Gesucht wird eine integre, intellektuell neugierige Persönlichkeit, die analytische Tiefe mit pragmatischer Umsetzung verbindet, Verantwortung übernimmt und Wirkung erzielen will.



  **Das bieten wir**







*  **Arbeiten für die Schweiz** Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.
*  **Gelebte Vielfalt** Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.
*  **Gesund am Arbeitsplatz** Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.


  **Ihr Einsatz für Sicherheit und Freiheit**



Der Armeestab (A Stab) unterstützt den Chef der Armee in der Führung des Departementsbereichs Verteidigung und verantwortet die militärische Gesamtplanung und \-entwicklung der Schweizer Armee. Hier werden gemäss den politischen Vorgaben die strategischen Grundlagen, die Streitkräfteentwicklung und die Armee\- und Rüstungsplanung erarbeitet sowie Aufgaben im internationalen Sicherheitskontext wahrgenommen. Die Führung, Steuerung und Koordination sämtlicher übergreifender Querschnittsbereiche (Personal, Finanzen, Immobilien) fallen ebenfalls in den Zuständigkeitsbereich des Armeestabs.  

Die Schweizer Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 110 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Schweizer Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

Senior Product Manager (m/f/d)
==============================

















Senior Product Manager (m/f/d)
==============================



Workload: 100% / Workplace: Sursee
----------------------------------

  





Quality in every moment starts with YOU \- as an international fashion player, we operate in a highly dynamic environment. Excellence, innovation and sustainability are at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you shape future\-ready Menswear and Kidswear collections that anticipate evolving consumer needs and translate them into distinctive, commercially successful product solutions. By combining creativity, consumer understanding and strategic thinking, you identify new opportunities, drive category growth and contribute to the future development of CALIDA's product offering. Together with your cross\-functional partners, you ensure that great product ideas become relevant, brand\-right and successful collections. Become part of the CALIDA Family and join us in shaping the textile future of tomorrow.





### Your Area of Responsibility





* You shape the Menswear and Kidswear category strategy and develop consumer\-relevant, brand\-right and commercially successful collections.
* You identify emerging consumer needs, market opportunities and category white spaces, translating them into impactful product concepts and category initiatives.
* You own the assortment and price architecture across the product life cycle, balancing consumer appeal, profitability and sustainability.
* You analyse market, consumer and product performance data and translate insights into clear commercial actions, forecasts and growth opportunities.
* You drive category performance and profitability in close collaboration with the Director Product \& Design, Design, Merchandising, and work closely with Operations, Marketing, and Controlling.
* You are equally comfortable analysing business performance, discussing product opportunities and driving execution to deliver results
* You challenge the status quo and continuously explore new ideas, innovative product concepts and opportunities to strengthen category relevance and future growth.
* You lead and develop Product Managers, set priorities and ensure high\-quality execution across the category.
* You coordinate collection\-related information and presentations across teams and support a successful go\-to\-market.
* You continuously improve processes, tools and ways of working and contribute to strategic cross\-functional projects.



### What We Value





* You have 8\+ years of experience in Product or Category Management within the apparel or textile industry; bodywear or nightwear experience is a plus.
* You have a degree in Business Administration, Apparel Management or a comparable field and bring strong apparel and textile expertise.
* You combine creativity, consumer curiosity and a strong sense for trends with strategic, analytical and commercial thinking.
* You understand how to connect consumer needs, brand objectives and business goals to create relevant and successful assortments.
* You take ownership, set clear priorities and turn ideas into action with an entrepreneurial and hands\-on mindset.
* You bring leadership experience and enjoy developing people and collaborating across functions.
* You are a confident communicator and presenter with a structured, quality\-focused way of working.
* You are fluent in and English and willing to travel when needed.









  

  



  



### Your Benefits













* Flexible working hours with mobile/remote working options









* Professional and personal development opportunities, including financial support for further education and career advancement









* Coverage of KTG (daily sickness benefits insurance) and NBU (non\-occupational accident insurance) premiums









* Free parking for all employees at the headquarters and discounted meals in our staff restaurant, Yellows









* Enjoy unforgettable moments at our regular CALIDA Yellow's aperitifs and our unique Christmas party









* Attractive employee discounts on our brands and regular outlet sales events

HR Specialist  
  
  
  
  



  



### Are you ready?



Our Recruitment Process

You can expect a transparent and personal recruitment process that puts your skills and personality at the centre.



**1\. Digital Check\-in (1 hour)**  
Start your journey with a virtual interview via Teams. It's an opportunity to get to know each other and learn more about your potential role \- all from the comfort of your home.



**2\. In\-person Meeting at our Headquarters in Sursee (2\-3 hours)**  
Following a successful first interview, we'll invite you to our headquarters in Sursee. You'll dive deeper into the role, meet the team in person and get a feel for our working environment during an office tour.



We only consider applications submitted through our careers page. For this position, we are unable to consider candidate profiles submitted by recruitment agencies.

Do you want to shape the future of marketing across Switzerland turning business priorities into high-impact campaigns, client experiences and measurable growth?

The role is a hands-on one that combines commercial strategy, client journey expertise, digital marketing execution, and performance analysis to maximize marketing's contribution to business growth across institutional, and intermediary client segments.
The Marketing Manager Switzerland serves as a strategic partner to sales, translating business priorities into data-driven marketing programs that drive client acquisition, deepen engagement, accelerate pipeline growth, and contribute to Net New Money (NNM). The role combines commercial strategy, client journey expertise, digital marketing excellence, and performance analytics to maximize marketing's contribution to business growth across institutional, wholesale, and intermediary client segments.

Commercial growth & business partnership

Client journey & demand generation

Drive adoption of digital engagement programs and scalable growth initiatives.

Data, insights & performance management

Continuously test, learn and improve campaign effectiveness

8+ years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, client engagement or commercial marketing.

Experienced, diverse team in an international environment.

Technician in Biogeosciences 50% (f/m/d)
========================================



















Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL  









The Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL is part of the ETH Domain. Approximately 600 people work on the sustainable use and protection of the environment and on the handling of natural hazards.



The Research Unit Forest and Soil Ecology assesses the impact of climate change and management on forests and their soils. The group Critical Zone dynamics is offering a **two\-year position** as



Technician in Biogeosciences 50% (f/m/d)
========================================



You will work within the recently funded SNSF project FIRE ("Fire Impacts on the Response of terrestrial Ecosystems"). This project investigates how wildfires affect carbon cycling and transit times at the landscape scale, particularly in the deeper unsaturated zone and in groundwater, and over longer periods of time. You will be part of an interdisciplinary team of collaborators based in Switzerland and the USA, and support the team in conducting geochemical analysis (particularly radiocarbon) on environmental samples from recently burned landscapes in the USA. Your main tasks will involve preparation of a range of sample types (gaseous, aqueous, and solid) for stable carbon isotope and radiocarbon analysis. This will be done in collaboration with our partners at the Laboratory for Beam Physics at ETH Zurich, where you will also frequently work. Processing of samples for other types of analysis, e.g., major ion concentrations, general chemistry, will also be part of your duties. You will support and train a PhD candidate and guests from our partner universities in the USA in laboratory procedures. Moreover, you will also assist the team with administrative and logistical duties, e.g., the shipping of samples and materials to and from field sites in the USA.





You preferably hold a Master's degree in environmental or earth sciences or related disciplines, and have demonstrated experience with mass spectrometric methods for geochemical analysis and/or radiocarbon methods. You are familiar with laboratory work, enjoy contributing to methodological advancements, and are interested in interdisciplinary and international research. You are able to work independently, are structured and accurate, communicative and team\-oriented. You have very good written and spoken English language skills. You will be part of a vibrant research group and an international team of leading researchers in biogeosciences, paleoclimatology, and terrestrial geochemistry. The position is based at WSL and initially fixed to two years with the option for prolongation for\- additional two years.



Please send your complete application to Pe, Human Resources WSL, by uploading the requested documents through our webpage. Review of the applications will begin on October 22, 2026\. Applications via email will not be considered. Lechleitner, , will be happy to answer any questions or offer further information. WSL is committed to diversity and inclusion as core values. We actively promote gender equality and foster an open, inclusive work environment.

title: Safeguarding and Ethical Leadership Coordinator for MSF Boards and Associations
description:
SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE
The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, and associative spaces free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB
The Safeguarding and Ethical Leadership Coordinator for Boards and Associations supports the implementation, operationalisation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of MSF’s safeguarding work with boards and associations across the MSF movement. This reflects the International Board’s commitment to minimum standards for safeguarding in associative networks.

The role:
leads coordination and implementation efforts that translate safeguarding principles, commitments, policies, and standards into practical, measurable, consistent, coherent, and sustainable safeguarding practices across MSF’s boards and associative structures.

advances safeguarding culture change by supporting MSF boards in understanding their role in safeguarding leadership and oversight; and by supporting the development of robust safeguarding understanding and putting in place safeguarding measures within associative structures and associations.

contributes to strengthening prevention, detection, reporting, response to safeguarding cases.

promotes accountability and institutional learning on safeguarding across the MSF movement.

ACCOUNTABILITIES
Coordination, design, and implementation :
Lead the coordination, implementation, and training on the ELMS, as well as on safeguarding, and other ethics principles within MSF boards.
Translate safeguarding and ELMS concepts into actionable documents, processes, and initiatives for MSF boards associations/networks in line with existing MSF initiatives on safeguarding.
Develop implementation guidance, tools, frameworks, templates, and operational resources.

Key Accountabilities :
Safeguarding ambitions are translated into practical implementation plans and deliverables.
Implementation progress is systematically tracked, monitored, and reported.
Approaches, tools, trainings, and guidance are developed and used by relevant stakeholders.

Drive safeguarding culture change :
Drive integration of safeguarding as a core organizational practice across MSF boards and associations.
Strengthen safeguarding accountability and leadership engagement, and ownership.
Other tasks assigned by the ISC or the International President or their delegate.

Lead monitoring, accountability, learning, and continuous improvement on Safeguarding and Ethical Governance :
Monitor implementation progress, identify risks and gaps, and drive corrective and improvement actions where needed.
Analyze ELMS and safeguarding implementation, challenges, and lessons learned to inform strategic decision-making.
Produce implementation reports, dashboards, briefing papers, presentations, and governance updates.
Lead learning and knowledge-sharing initiatives related to safeguarding and ELMS implementation and best practices.

Key Accountabilities :
Safeguarding is embedded into MSF associations and boards’ ways of working.
Safeguarding considerations are integrated into associative and boards’ processes.
Organisational awareness and ownership of safeguarding responsibilities is increased across the MSF associations and boards.

Coordinate the framework and response to ELMS and safeguarding complaints involving senior leadership :
Ensure relevant frameworks and processes relating to triage, case management, investigation, and decision-making are implemented for ELMS and safeguarding complaints involving senior leadership (the incumbent will not engage, case management, investigations or decision-making directly, but rather ensure it is in place).
Reception, and coordination, initial review and assessment of safeguarding and ELMs allegations involving senior leadership (i.e. General Directors and board members). Ensure a decision-making panel is formed for ELMS-related complaints, and ensure their decision is reported to the International Board.

Key Accountabilities :
Ensure that ELMs related complaints are properly assigned to relevant experts for case management/investigation.
Ensure a decision-making panel is formed for safeguarding or ELMs-related complaints, and ensure their decision is reported to the International Board.

AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY
The role is responsible under the technical supervision of the ISC and the hierarchical supervision of the International President (or the IP’s delegate). The role will coordinate closely with:
the Board Strengthening Programme concerning board training and direct board support activities with respect to safeguarding and ELMS implementation.
the International Associative Team to ensure appropriate association support and training activities with respect to safeguarding.
the ILD to ensure legal risks and statutory requirements are duly considered.

The role uses subject matter expertise, analysis, independent judgement and translates safeguarding, and ethical governance initiatives (such as the Ethical Leadership and Minimum Standards), and other safeguarding initiatives and concepts into relatable, understood, actionable documents, trainings, and actionable initiatives that support to ensure all parts of MSF have a robust understanding of, and structures that support safeguarding.

The role needs a strong understanding of, safeguarding policies, codes of conducts-including ethical governance principles, and how to draft them for associations (non-staff), alongside an understanding of the role of trustees and Boards as oversight for safeguarding.

The incumbent will also need to understand case management and administrative investigations to be able to explain these concepts and how they relate to oversight and associations.

The incumbent will also need to have good understanding of confidentiality, and act with the utmost discretion, when following up, and arranging that safeguarding and ELMs complaints involving senior leadership are properly and promptly addressed.

Job requirements
Education
A master's degree in relevant field such as law, human rights, administration etc. Or a bachelor's degree combined with significant relevant experience in safeguarding, governance of non-profits.

Experience
A minimum of 5 years implementing safeguarding initiatives, especially with boards.
Strong understanding of case management and administrative investigations in a workplace setting and principles guiding case management and ability to explain these concepts.
Experience working with or as a board member for a non-profit organization.
Experience drafting key safeguarding documents.
Experience in designing and delivering safeguarding training.
MSF experience is an asset.

Knowledge / Skills :
Strong understanding of safeguarding, conflicts of interest and the role of a trustee/governance of non-profit organisations.
Ability to draft appropriate and relevant safeguarding standards/documents and to translate complex concepts into clear actions.
Ability to coordinate and work with a range of stakeholders in a consultative, diplomatic fashion.
Strong writing skills and ability to communicate safeguarding concepts simply to a range of audiences.
A strong understanding of monitoring and evaluation.
Demonstrated experience in coordinating or overseeing highly sensitive cases involving senior leadership; receiving and appropriately triaging sensitive allegations; governance and due-process principles; management of conflicts of interest and recusal; commissioning and oversight of independent investigations; confidentiality, secure information management and data protection; whistleblowing and retaliation considerations; and the ability to navigate complex situations involving boards, senior executives, safeguarding and legal functions.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex implementation and coordination initiatives across diverse stakeholders.
Ability to influence organisational change in multicultural environments.
Strong strategic coordination and implementation management skills.
Perseverance and ability to build consensus.
Independence of judgement and the ability to challenge senior stakeholders, when necessary, alongside diplomacy and consensus-building.
Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and follow-through across multiple workstreams.
Ability to navigate sensitive safeguarding issues with discretion, diplomacy, and sound judgement.
Cross cultural awareness and strong commitment to and understanding of diversity, equity, and inclusion principles.

Languages :
English, other languages are an asset, especially French and Spanish.

Other :
Motivation to work in a humanitarian organisation and a fast paced, dynamic environment.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Gruppenleitung 80-100% für die Region Illnau-Effretikon gesucht
description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Illnau-Effretikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Gruppenleitung.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Illnau-Effretikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Gruppenleitung

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Illnau-Effretikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Illnau-Effretikon liegt in der Zürcher Landschaft und bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Arbeitsumgebung mit guter Infrastruktur. Die Region ist dank der S-Bahn-Anbindung schnell mit Zürich verbunden und besticht durch ihre Nähe zu Natur und Erholungsräumen. Zahlreiche etablierte Unternehmen haben sich hier angesiedelt, was ein vielfältiges Angebot an Arbeitsstellen schafft. Sie profitieren von günstigen Mieten gegenüber der Stadt, während Sie gleichzeitig urban erreichbar bleiben.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Gruppenleitung

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
In der Region Illnau-Effretikon besteht eine konstant hohe Nachfrage nach erfahrenen Pflegefachpersonen mit Gruppenleitungsfunktion, da Fachkräfte in diesem Bereich knapp sind. Mit Ihrer Qualifikation auf HF/FH-Niveau eröffnen sich Ihnen ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem lokalen Arbeitsmarkt, insbesondere in Alters- und Pflegeheimen sowie Spitälern. iPersonal vereinfacht Ihren Einstieg durch spezialisierte Vermittlung, fundierte Kenntnisse des regionalen Marktes und die Begleitung beim Bewerbungsprozess, sodass Sie schnell eine passende Führungsposition finden.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Illnau-Effretikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie auf med-ipersonal.ch – täglich aktualisiert.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

- Bewerben Sie sich deshalb jetzt als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Illnau-Effretikon. Wir vermitteln schnell und persönlich, denn gute Fachkräfte verdienen ebenso gute Partner.

Senior Robotics Engineer / Postdoctoral Researcher 60\-100 %
============================================================





We are looking for a postdoctoral researcher or senior robotics engineer. Take humanoid and quadruped robots out of the lab and into industry: with Swiss partners, you deploy reinforcement learning, robot foundation models and agentic systems in the real world.

Senior Robotics Engineer / Postdoctoral Researcher 60\-100 %
============================================================



**School:**



School of Engineering



**Starting date:**



January 2027 or by appointment.



**Your role**







* You conduct applied research and development as a senior robotics engineer / postdoctoral researcher in the Embodied Mobile Agents (EMA) research group, deploying reinforcement learning and VLA/WAM policies on humanoid and quadruped robots in the real world.
* You drive our current focus topics: flexible industrial automation through agentic embodied AI systems, robotic foundation models and reinforcement learning for mobile manipulation. In a new project, we will be looking into lowering the entry barrier to robot teleoperation and imitation learning for non\-technical users through automated dataset curation and real\-time feedback.
* You turn results into publications and open\-source code contributions.
* You collaborate with companies, universities and other partners in Switzerland and the EU. Most of our projects are applied research and innovation projects with Swiss companies, mainly funded by Innosuisse.


**Your profile**







* You hold a PhD in robotics, or in computer science or a related field with a focus on AI for robotics.
* You are a pragmatic "maker" with a strong drive to build things that work and are appealing to use, and you have hands\-on experience with real robots, including prototyping and modifying robots with off\-the\-shelf equipment.
* You have proven competencies in robot learning (reinforcement learning, imitation learning, robot foundation models) and in classical robotics (motion planning, perception and navigation, teleoperation).
* You are a strong programmer and work confidently with ROS / ROS 2, Nav2, MoveIt, PCL, OpenCV, the NVIDIA Jetson ecosystem and current deep learning frameworks.
* You have a strong research track record in AI for robotics or computer vision, shown by publications, and your curiosity keeps you on top of the state of the art.
* You are fluent in English; is a plus.
* We offer a position at the level of research associate, initially limited to 2 years.


**This is what we stand for**



Zurich University of Applied Sciences ZHAW is one of Switzerland's largest multidisciplinary universities of applied sciences, with over 14'000 students and 3'400 faculty and staff.  

The School of Engineering ( ), as one of the leading educational and research institutions in Switzerland, focuses on topics relevant to the future. 14 institutes and centres guarantee high\-quality education, research and development with a focus on the areas of energy, mobility, information and health.  

The Centre for Artificial Intelligence ( ) maintains a growing number of research groups in four strategic focus areas: . The CAI conducts method\-focused applied re\-search and development at the highest level in the field of machine learning and is committed to a human\-centered ap\-proach to artificial intelligence, thereby actively shaping the ethical dimension.  

We are looking for a witty, sharp, curious, and technically skilled personality. We value potential over formally certified skills, encouraging also unconventional CVs, e.g., transdisciplinary backgrounds or own entrepreneurial experience. Please honor us with a tailored cover letter and highlight facts that underline your ability to achieve high. We are looking forward to hearing from you!  

ZHAW is committed to gender\-mixed and diverse teams in order to promote equality, diversity and innovation.



**What you can expect**



We offer working conditions and terms of employment commensurate with higher education institutions and actively promote personal development for staff in leadership and non\-leadership positions. A detailed description of advantages and benefits can be found at . The main points are listed below:

Die **MEWA Service AG** gehört zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich nachhaltiges Textilmanagement und steht seit über 100 Jahren für Qualität, Innovation und durchdachte Full\-Service\-Lösungen. Was einst mit wiederverwendbaren Putztüchern begann, hat sich zu einer international erfolgreichen Unternehmensgruppe mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden und Standorten in ganz Europa entwickelt. Gerade die Kombination aus hochwertigen Produkten, persönlichem Service und langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen macht das Unternehmen seit Jahren erfolgreich. Gleichzeitig bietet MEWA ein modernes, stabiles Umfeld mit klaren Strukturen, hoher Kundenorientierung und langfristiger Perspektive.







Im Zuge des weiteren Wachstums suchen wir im **exklusiven Mandatsauftrag** eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die gemeinsam mit einem starken Team den Schweizer Markt aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln möchte.



Quereinstieg. Remote. Vertriebsassistentin Outbound
===================================================







**Dein Alltag**



Du hast Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, gehst offen auf andere zu und schaffst es, mit deiner sympathischen Interesse zu wecken? Dann bietet dir diese Position die ideale Möglichkeit, in den Vertrieb einzusteigen und dich langfristig weiterzuentwickeln – **auch als Quereinstieg möglich.**







Als wichtige Unterstützung des Account Managers bist du die erste Ansprechperson für potenzielle Neukunden und legst den Grundstein für erfolgreiche Geschäftsbeziehungen. Mit deiner offenen kontaktierst du Unternehmen telefonisch, identifizierst interessante Ansprechpartner und vereinbarst Termine für den Account Manager. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du bei der Planung der Kundenbesuche und sorgst dafür, dass Verkaufsaktivitäten optimal vorbereitet sind. Darüber hinaus recherchierst du neue potenzielle Kunden, erweiterst die bestehende Datenbank und trägst aktiv dazu bei, neue Marktpotenziale zu erschliessen. Mit deinem Gespür für Menschen, deiner Hartnäckigkeit und deiner positiven leistest du einen direkten Beitrag zum Vertriebserfolg.







**Dein Profil**



* Freude am Telefonieren und am aktiven Austausch mit Menschen
* Kommunikationsstarke, offene und sympathische Persönlichkeit
* Überzeugungskraft sowie ein sicheres und selbstbewusstes Auftreten
* Organisationstalent und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
* Eigeninitiative, Zielorientierung und Durchhaltevermögen
* Freude daran, neue Kontakte aufzubauen und Chancen zu erkennen
* Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, ösischkenntnisse von Vorteil






**Deine Benefits**



Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung und einem hohen Mass an Flexibilität. Du arbeitest vollständig aus dem Homeoffice und profitierst gleichzeitig von den Strukturen, der Stabilität und den Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten eines erfolgreichen Unternehmens. Neben einem Fixlohn profitierst du von einem leistungsorientierten Provisionsmodell mit entsprechendem Verdienstpotenzial und überdurchschnittlichen Sozialleistungen. Für deinen Homeoffice\-Arbeitsplatz wird Dir ein Laptop sowie ein Headset zur Verfügung gestellt. Dank flexiblen Arbeitszeiten organisierst du deinen Arbeitstag selbstständig, eigenverantwortlich sowie gewinnbringend. Gleichzeitig bietet dir MEWA 5 Wochen Urlaub, ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung anerkannt wird, kurze Entscheidungswege gelebt werden und Teamgeist nicht nur ein Schlagwort ist. \- und Weihnachtsfeste sowie ein wertschätzendes Miteinander gehören hier genauso dazu wie Vertrauen und unternehmerische Freiheit im Alltag.

Chef du département pistes et sécurité (H/F) à 100%, CDI
============================================================

La société « Remontées Mécaniques de Crans\-Montana Aminona » (CMA SA) exploite le domaine skiable de Crans\-Montana dont le point culminant (Glacier de la Plaine Morte) se situe à près de 3'000 m. d’altitude. En hiver le domaine skiable de Crans\-Montana propose 140 kilomètres de pistes avec une diversité exceptionnelle pour tous les niveaux. Notre réseau de piste étant orienté plein sud, nos skieurs bénéficient d’un ensoleillement privilégié tout au long de la saison dans un décor grandiose. Afin de compléter ses équipes, la société des Remontées Mécaniques de Crans\-Montana Aminona (CMA SA), recherche ;



### **Chef du département pistes et sécurité (H/F) à 100%, CDI**



**VOS MISSIONS :**

* Assurer et coordonner la mise en œuvre des aspects opérationnels et sécuritaires du département pistes, soit le service sécurité en hiver ainsi que les pistes VTT, de karting et autres activités d’été qui empruntent le domaine skiable en été.
* Appliquer la stratégie de l’entreprise.
* Participer et organiser les actions de sauvetage sur les remontées mécaniques (sur le câble ou au sol).
* Contrôler les directives et instructions applicables au département.
* Organiser le suivi des budgets et prendre les mesures nécessaires pour les faire respecter.
* Assurer la gestion des collaborateurs avec les chefs de secteur.
* Contrôler le bon état de fonctionnement du matériel du département.
* Traiter ou sous\-traiter des projets des investissements de terrassement et amélioration du département.
* Valider les commandes et le choix des fournisseurs pour les achats du département.




**VOTRE PROFIL :**

* Au bénéfice d’une expérience confirmée dans le domaine des remontées mécaniques.
* Brevet fédéral de spécialiste du service de pistes et de sauvetage est un plus ou une formation jugée équivalente reconnue par les RMS.
* Sens aigu de l’organisation, de très bonnes facultés d’analyse et aimer prendre des érience réussie dans la gestion d’équipe et faire preuve de leadership au quotidien.
* Capacité à travailler en équipe indispensableFlexible, consciencieux et engagé.
* En mesure de travailler dans un milieu contraignant.Résistance au stress et aux conditions météorologiques difficiles.
* niveau en ski/snowboard et être apte à effectuer des travaux en hauteur.
* Permis de conduire et un véhicule personnel sont indispensables.




**NOS PRESTATIONS :**

* Un poste à l’année avec un contrat à durée indéterminée.
* Un environnement prestations sociales d’une grande entreprise.
* Un métier très varié et sans routine.




**NOS AVANTAGES :**

* Abonnement de ski gratuit (enfants et conjoint également).
* Prime de fidélité chaque 5 ans.
* Parking gratuit.
* Cantine d’entreprise.
* Révision annuelle gratuite des équipements de ski.
* Entrée à convenir.
*
* Si vous êtes à la recherche d’un nouveau défi stimulant vous permettant de travailler de manière autonome et de vous dépasser, envoyez votre dossier complet avant le 12 novembre 2026\.

Manager (m/w/d) \- Bedano
=========================

**Manager (m/f/d) \- Bedano**

Raben AG è un’azienda logistica moderna e dinamica, specializzata in soluzioni di trasporto e spedizione a livello internazionale. Come parte di un solido gruppo europeo, uniamo affidabilità, efficienza e attenzione al cliente a una lunga esperienza nel settore della logistica.

Le nostre persone sono la chiave del nostro successo. Per questo promuoviamo lo spirito di squadra, la responsabilità individuale e le opportunità di crescita professionale in un ambiente internazionale.

Per rafforzare il nostro team commerciale presso la sede di **Bedano**, siamo alla ricerca di una persona motivata e orientata ai risultati per la posizione di  **Manager (m/f/d)**, capace di combinare spirito imprenditoriale, competenze commerciali e una forte attenzione alle esigenze dei clienti.

In questo ruolo avrai un’importante responsabilità nello sviluppo del portafoglio clienti e nel rafforzamento della nostra presenza sul mercato ticinese. Grazie alla tua capacità di individuare nuove opportunità di business, costruire relazioni durature e proporre soluzioni personalizzate, contribuirai attivamente alla crescita sostenibile della nostra azienda.



**Le tue responsabilità**

* Acquisire attivamente nuovi clienti e sviluppare relazioni commerciali solide e durature.
* Gestire e ampliare il portafoglio clienti esistente, individuando ulteriori opportunità di sviluppo.
* Sviluppare autonomamente il territorio commerciale di competenza, rafforzando la presenza di Raben AG sul mercato ticinese.
* Analizzare il mercato, identificare nuove opportunità commerciali e trasformarle in concrete occasioni di la responsabilità del raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita e fatturato.
* Presentare le nostre soluzioni di trasporto e logistica in modo mirato, individuando le proposte più adatte alle esigenze dei clienti.
* Collaborare strettamente con il team interno e con i reparti operativi per garantire un servizio efficiente e di qualità.
* Monitorare l’evoluzione del mercato e della concorrenza, contribuendo con idee e iniziative allo sviluppo delle attività commerciali.




**Il tuo profilo**

* Formazione commerciale completata nel settore delle spedizioni oppure formazione equivalente o esperienza professionale pertinente dei trasporti e della logistica.
* Esperienza nella vendita esterna ( ), preferibilmente nel settore della logistica dei trasporti terrestri.
* Buona conoscenza del mercato ticinese e capacità di sviluppare una rete di contatti commerciali nella regione.
* orientamento alla vendita, con entusiasmo per l’acquisizione di nuovi clienti e la gestione dei rapporti commerciali.
* Metodo di lavoro autonomo, strutturato e orientato agli obiettivi, accompagnato da elevata motivazione personale.
* Spiccate capacità comunicative e negoziali, con un approccio professionale e sicuro nei confronti di clienti e partner.
* Personalità affidabile, dinamica e orientata alle soluzioni, con spirito imprenditoriale e attitudine al lavoro di squadra.
* Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e buona conoscenza dell’inglese; la conoscenza del tedesco rappresenta un titolo preferenziale.




**Cosa ti offriamo**

* 25 giorni di ferie all’anno, con la possibilità di acquistare ulteriori giorni di vacanza.
* Orari di lavoro flessibili.
* Ampia autonomia e fiducia nelle tue capacità decisionali.
* Un ruolo dinamico con notevole libertà organizzativa e possibilità di sviluppare le tue idee.
