Lead Chemical Process R\&D Scientist
====================================




Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long\-term client, F. \-La AG in Basel, we are looking for a

**Lead Chemical Process R\&D Scientist**
========================================

**Background:**

In this function you will lead chemical process R\&D activities to deliver safe, scalable, efficient and sustainable processes as well as drug substance material for projects in clinical development, with a focus on late stage development, leveraging internal and external CDMO capabilities.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

* Lead Internal \& External Chemical Process R\&D activities: Direct chemical process research and development work, managing an internal team of 1–5 process chemists and/or leading external activities at contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs)
* Oversee end\-to\-end process chemistry workflows, including synthetic route scouting, process optimization, scale\-up, and support for supply activities.
* Coordinate Cross\-Functional Delivery: Synchronize internal laboratory efforts with CDMO timelines to guarantee the timely, safe, and cost\-effective production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and advanced intermediates
* Ensure Quality \& Compliance: Deliver the target compounds following internal quality processes and according to specifications, safety standards and sustainability objectives.


**Must Haves:**

* PhD or Postdoctoral background in Synthetic Organic Chemistry.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in pharmaceutical chemical process R\&D, with demonstrated expertise in late\-stage process development and scale\-up.
* Leadership \& Project Management: Proven track record of leading, mentoring, and driving project deliverables within internal process chemistry teams.
* CDMO Management: Direct experience managing external chemical development, technology transfers, and manufacturing activities at CDMOs.
* Technical \& Software Proficiency: High proficiency with standard office applications alongside core chemistry tools, including chemical drawing tools, literature/patent search engines, Design of Experiments (DoE) applications, analytical software, and project planning platforms. Proficiency in the use of kinetic modeling or scale\-up simulation software is a plus.
* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required


**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity or prior experience working within Manufacturing Practice (GMP) environments is an advantage, though not strictly required.

* Professional working proficiency or fluency in is a plus.

**What you will be offered:**

* An opportunity to work in one of the world's most important pharmaceutical companies
* Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting areas
* Central location in Basel
* Varied job profile
* Further training opportunities through temptraining
* Working in a dynamic and motivated team

### description:

We are looking for an experienced Manager, Project Engineering – CQV to lead Commissioning, Qualification and Validation (CQV) activities across a portfolio of biopharmaceutical CAPEX projects in Visp, Switzerland.

In this role, you will combine technical expertise, project management and team leadership to ensure that facilities, equipment and manufacturing processes are commissioned and qualified in accordance with GEP/cGMP requirements, quality standards, project schedules and budgets.

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop and implement CQV strategies, execution plans and quality plans for CAPEX investments, ensuring alignment with global standards and regulatory requirements.
* Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams of engineers, technicians and internal/external project resources across multiple locations.
* Manage resource allocation, budget estimations, project schedules and milestones, identifying risks and implementing corrective actions where necessary.
* Oversee commissioning, Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ) and other relevant validation activities.
* Ensure the preparation, execution and review of accurate and compliant qualification protocols, documentation and reports.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality and Regulatory Affairs to integrate CQV activities into overall project execution.
* Act as a Subject Expert (SME) for CQV, providing technical guidance and supporting project governance and risk mitigation.
* Drive continuous improvement through process standardization, training, knowledge sharing and cross\-functional collaboration.


### About the customer:

Our client is a leading global organization in the life sciences and biopharmaceutical manufacturing industry, specializing in the development and production of innovative pharmaceutical products. Operating in a highly regulated environment, the organization invests in state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities and advanced technologies to support complex biopharmaceutical processes.

* Master's degree in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences or a related technical discipline.
* Approximately 8–15 years of professional experience in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical engineering environments.
* Proven experience delivering CAPEX projects within GEP/GMP\-regulated biopharmaceutical facilities.
* Demonstrated experience leading Commissioning, Qualification and Validation (CQV) projects or programs.
* Strong knowledge of cGMP requirements, pharmaceutical contract manufacturing and fill\-and\-finish facilities and processes.

* Demonstrated success in standardizing CQV processes and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

Infirmier
=========

 

### Introduction

 

Vous êtes passionné(e) par les soins infirmiers et souhaitez rejoindre une équipe dynamique et bienveillante ? Ô Santé Sàrl, une entreprise de soins à domicile dédiée à la santé et au bien\-être, recherche un(e) Infirmier(ère) motivé(e) pour renforcer son équipe en Suisse. Si vous êtes à la recherche d'une opportunité enrichissante dans un environnement stimulant, cette offre est faite pour vous !

 

### Responsabilités

 

En tant qu'Infirmier(ère) chez Ô Santé Sàrl, vos principales missions incluront :

* Assurer des soins infirmiers de qualité aux patients, en respectant les protocoles et les normes en vigueur.
* Évaluer les besoins des patients et élaborer des plans de soins personnalisés.
* Collaborer avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire pour garantir un suivi optimal des patients.
* Assurer la gestion et le suivi des dossiers médicaux.
* Participer à l'éducation thérapeutique des patients et de leurs familles.
* Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques et des services de soins.


 

### Qualifications

 

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devez répondre aux critères suivants :

* Diplôme reconnu d'Infirmier(ère) (HES ou équivalent).
* Autorisation de pratiquer en Suisse (croix rouge si nécessaire).
* Expérience préalable en soins infirmiers, idéalement dans un environnement similaire.
* Excellentes compétences en communication et en relation interpersonnelle.
* Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.
* Maîtrise du français (oral et écrit) ; la connaissance d'autres langues est un atout.
* Flexibilité et capacité d'adaptation à des situations variées.


 

### Avantages

 

En rejoignant Ô Santé Sàrl, vous bénéficierez de :

* Un environnement de travail stimulant et bienveillant.
* Des opportunités de formation continue et de développement professionnel.
* Un salaire compétitif et des avantages sociaux attractifs.
* Un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle.
* Une équipe soudée et collaborative.


 

### Informations pour postuler

 

Si vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi et à contribuer à l'excellence des soins chez Ô Santé Sàrl, nous vous invitons à soumettre votre candidature via notre site internet. Nous avons hâte de découvrir votre profil et de vous accueillir dans notre équipe !

  **Background:**



In this function you will lead chemical process R\&D activities to deliver safe, scalable, efficient and sustainable processes as well as drug substance material for projects in clinical development, with a focus on late\-stage development, leveraging internal and external CDMO capabilities.



  



  **The Perfect Candidate:**



The ideal candidate is a PhD/PostDoc\-level organic chemist with 5\+ years of pharmaceutical R\&D experience specializing in late\-stage process optimization and scale\-up. They bring demonstrated leadership in guiding internal project teams and managing CDMO operations, technical transfers, and material supply. Fluent in English, they marry outstanding scientific acumen with strong organizational skills. They are an articulate, collaborative communicator who effectively motivates teams to deliver safe, scalable, and sustainable chemical processes.







  **Tasks \& Responsibilities:**



* Lead Internal \& External Chemical Process R\&D activities: Direct chemical process research and development work, managing an internal team of 1\-5 process chemists and/or leading external activities at contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).
* Oversee end\-to\-end process chemistry workflows, including synthetic route scouting, process optimization, scale\-up, and support for supply activities.
* Coordinate Cross\-Functional Delivery: Synchronize internal laboratory efforts with CDMO timelines to guarantee the timely, safe, and cost\-effective production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and advanced intermediates
* Ensure Quality \& Compliance: Deliver the target compounds following internal quality processes and according to specifications, safety standards and sustainability objectives.


  



  **Must Haves:**



* PhD or Postdoctoral background in Synthetic Organic Chemistry.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in pharmaceutical chemical process R\&D, with demonstrated expertise in late\-stage process development and scale\-up.
* Leadership \& Project Management: Proven track record of leading, mentoring, and driving project deliverables within internal process chemistry teams.
* CDMO Management: Direct experience managing external chemical development, technology transfers, and manufacturing activities at CDMOs.
* Technical \& Software Proficiency: High proficiency with standard office applications alongside core chemistry tools, including chemical drawing tools, literature/patent search engines, Design of Experiments (DoE) applications, analytical software, and project planning platforms. Proficiency in the use of kinetic modeling or scale\-up simulation software is a plus.
* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.


  



  **Nice to Haves:**



* Familiarity or prior experience working within Manufacturing Practice (GMP) environments is an advantage, though not strictly required.
* Professional working proficiency or fluency in is a plus.

Flux logistiques internationaux complexes (Grand Import) et gestion de produits périssables multi\-températures (sec, frais, surgelé).*

**1\. IDENTIFICATION DU POSTE**

**Intitulé du poste :** Approvisionneur Junior / Gestionnaire de Flux Import B2B

**Rattachement hiérarchique :** Responsable Approvisionnements / Responsable Supply Chain

**Interfaces internes :** Acheteurs, Commerciaux, Transitaires, Responsable Entrepôt/Logistique

**Interfaces externes :** Fournisseurs internationaux (Asie/Japon/US/UE), Transporteurs, Commissionnaires en douane

**2\. MISSION PRINCIPALE**

Sous la supervision du Responsable Approvisionnements, l'Approvisionneur Junior assure la disponibilité optimale des produits phares de la gastronomie asiatique (épicerie, produits frais/surgelés, sakés, packagings client) tout en garantissant un niveau de stock maîtrisé. Il gère l'intégralité du flux d'approvisionnement depuis la passation de commande à l'international jusqu'à la livraison finale à l'entrepôt logistique B2B, dans le respect strict des réglementations douanières et sanitaires propres à l'agroalimentaire.

Nous recherchons une personne motivée, dynamique et proactive, qui fait preuve d’initiative et d’un bon esprit d’analyse.

Vous êtes capable de prendre du recul face aux situations, d’identifier les problèmes et de proposer des solutions concrètes, plutôt que de vous arrêter aux difficultés rencontrées.

Vous avez le sens des responsabilités, êtes autonome et savez faire preuve de remise en question. Vous accueillez les remarques constructives avec ouverture et les considérez comme des occasions de progresser.

Une bonne base de connaissances dans le domaine est souhaitée, mais une longue expérience n’est pas indispensable. Nous accordons davantage d’importance à votre motivation, à votre capacité de réflexion et à votre volonté d’apprendre.

Une formation et un accompagnement seront assurés afin de vous permettre de développer vos compétences et d’évoluer dans votre fonction.

**3\. MISSIONS ET ACTIVITÉS LOGISTIQUES**

**A. Gestion opérationnelle des importations (grand import \+ europe)**

**Calculer et planifier :** les besoins de commandes selon l'état des stocks, les prévisions de ventes commerciales et la saisonnalité des produits (ex: pics de fin d'année, festivals).

**Saisir et émettre :** les commandes d'achat internationales dans l'ERP d'après le catalogue des fournisseurs référencés.

**Coordonner :** le transport international (FCL/LCL maritime, aérien) en lien direct avec les transitaires et optimiser le taux de remplissage des conteneurs.

**Sécuriser :** la bonne constitution des dossiers d'importation (factures, Bill of Lading, certificats sanitaires d'origine, certificats de non\-radiation, agréments phytosanitaires).

**B. Pilotage des stocks et respect de la chaîne de valeur agroalimentaire**

**Surveiller la rotation :** les dates limites de consommation (DLC) et dates de durabilité minimale (DDM) afin de minimiser la démarque sur les produits ultra\-frais et secs.

**Ajuster en continu :** les niveaux de stock par rapport à la capacité de stockage multi\-températures de l'entrepôt (sec, frais à \+4°C, surgelé à \-18°C).

**Anticiper :** les ruptures de stock sur les produits stratégiques (ex: riz premium, sauces soja de spécialité, sakés de garde) et alerter immédiatement la force commerciale en cas de retard de conteneur.

**C. Gestion opérationnelle de la relation fournisseur et traitement des litiges**

**Suivre :** quotidiennement les délais de production fournisseur et confirmer les dates d'embarquement.

**Gérer :** les anomalies de réception (avaries de transport, écarts quantitatifs, non\-conformités de température) et piloter les dossiers de réclamation / avoirs auprès des tiers.

**Évaluer :** le taux de service fournisseur (KPI et soumettre des bilans réguliers au responsable).

title: Surface Treatment Specialist 100%
description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of experience delivering customized maintenance, repair, and overhaul solutions to more than 300 customers worldwide. With a strong global network and a commitment to innovation, excellence, and sustainability, we safely power our customers’ flights every day.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas in our department Piece Part Repair at Zurich Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Surface Treatment Specialist position.

Surface Treatment Specialist 100%

As a Surface Treatment Specialist you will:
- Prepare engine components (e.g. leaning, masking, degreasing)
- Perform surface finishing processes (e.g. coating, plating)
- Conduct mechanical finishing tasks such as grinding and blending
- Carry out self‑inspection and document results
- Operate and monitor treatment processes and equipment
- Follow safety, quality and chemical‑handling standards
- Apply 5S and support continuous improvement initiatives

Your Profile
- Completed technical apprenticeship (surface treatment, mechanics, production, or similar)
- Experience in paint, coating, blending or plating
- Reliable, accurate and quality‑driven work style
- Team‑oriented, flexible, dependable
- Good German skills (minimum B2); English beneficial

description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Reponsable d'unité --- Reponsable d'unité =================== La \*\*Fondation Enfance Emma Couvreu depuis 1829\*\* s'engage activement dans l'accueil, la protection et le soutien de mineurs en danger dans leur développement. Nos prestations s'adressent aux enfants et également à leurs parents. Nous mettons en œuvre nos actions en concordance avec des valeurs que nous incarnons au quotidien. Nos activités s'inscrivent pleinement dans la politique de protection des mineurs édictée par l'État de Vaud. Forte de son engagement, la Fondation gère 5 internats et 6 unités ambulatoires, mobilisant pour cela plus de 250 collaboratrices et collaborateurs. Le \*\*Pôle de compétences éducatives en milieu scolaire (PEMS)\*\* est un organe désigné par la DGEJ pour gérer et coordonner les prestations socioéducatives d'une région scolaire, notamment les éducateurs·trices sociaux·ales en milieu scolaire (ESS) et les modules d'activités temporaires et alternatives à la scolarité (MATAS). Senior IT Systems \& Network Administrator
==========================================

Position Summary
----------------

We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on IT professional to take operational ownership of the school's day\-to\-day IT environment.

This is a senior, campus\- based technical position combining systems administration, enterprise networking and high\-quality user support.

The successful candidate will independently diagnose and resolve complex incidents, maintain the reliability of core IT services and anticipate issues before they disrupt teaching and learning.

They will serve as a key on\-site IT contact for staff and work closely with Regional and Global IT teams, following Group technical standards, security policies and change\-management procedures.

The role requires sound technical judgement, clear communication and the ability to plan, prioritise and

deliver work with limited day\-to\-day supervision. It is a hands\-on position rather than a people\-management role.



Key Responsibilities

**Campus IT Operations \& Technical Ownership**

* Take day\-to\-day ownership of campus IT operations, from incident triage and diagnosis through resolution, documentation and follow\-up.
* Independently prioritise support requests and operational tasks, with particular urgency for incidents affecting lessons, examinations and essential school services.
* Proactively monitor recurring issues, service health and technology risks; recommend and implement practical improvements within delegated authority.
* Act as the senior on\-site technical contact, coordinating with school stakeholders, IT colleagues and external suppliers; escalate significant incidents with clear technical evidence and business impact.


**Systems, Microsoft 365 \& Identity Management**

* Administer Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID, including users, groups, licences, role\-appropriate access permissions, authentication and account lifecycle processes.
* Operate and troubleshoot Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online, including mailboxes, collaboration services and access\-related incidents.
* Support secure identity practices, including MFA, access controls and the implementation of centrally defined security policies.

Lead Chemical Process R\&D Scientist

Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long\-term client, F. \-La AG in Basel, we are looking for a

**Lead Chemical Process R\&D Scientist**

**Background:**

In this function you will lead chemical process R\&D activities to deliver safe, scalable, efficient and sustainable processes as well as drug substance material for projects in clinical development, with a focus on late stage development, leveraging internal and external CDMO capabilities.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

* Lead Internal \& External Chemical Process R\&D activities: Direct chemical process research and development work, managing an internal team of 1–5 process chemists and/or leading external activities at contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs)
* Oversee end\-to\-end process chemistry workflows, including synthetic route scouting, process optimization, scale\-up, and support for supply activities.
* Coordinate Cross\-Functional Delivery: Synchronize internal laboratory efforts with CDMO timelines to guarantee the timely, safe, and cost\-effective production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and advanced intermediates
* Ensure Quality \& Compliance: Deliver the target compounds following internal quality processes and according to specifications, safety standards and sustainability objectives.


**Must Haves:**

* PhD or Postdoctoral background in Synthetic Organic Chemistry.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in pharmaceutical chemical process R\&D, with demonstrated expertise in late\-stage process development and scale\-up.
* Leadership \& Project Management: Proven track record of leading, mentoring, and driving project deliverables within internal process chemistry teams.
* CDMO Management: Direct experience managing external chemical development, technology transfers, and manufacturing activities at CDMOs.
* Technical \& Software Proficiency: High proficiency with standard office applications alongside core chemistry tools, including chemical drawing tools, literature/patent search engines, Design of Experiments (DoE) applications, analytical software, and project planning platforms. Proficiency in the use of kinetic modeling or scale\-up simulation software is a plus.
* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required

============================================

Bei **ABB** unterstützen wir Industrien dabei, effizienter und sauberer zu arbeiten – und jede einzelne Person trägt hier dazu bei. Wir bieten allen Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und die eigene Entwicklung aktiv voranzutreiben. Gemeinsam entstehen Lösungen, auf die alle stolz sein können. Local Division Manager

\_\_

In dieser Position verbringen Sie rund 80 % Ihrer Arbeitszeit direkt bei Kundinnen und Kunden. Sie gewinnen neue Geschäftspartner\*innen, bauen bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nachhaltig aus und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter. * Markt\- und Branchenkenntnisse: Sie beobachten Markttrends und Entwicklungen im Bereich Drives \& Motion und bringen neue Ideen und Impulse aktiv ein.  


**Ihr Profil**

* Abgeschlossenes Studium oder technische Ausbildung in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen im Bereich Elektromotoren und Frequenzumrichter (LV \& MV)
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations\- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten
* Hohe Reisebereitschaft (ca. 80 % Aussendiensttätigkeit)
* Begeisterung für energieeffiziente und nachhaltige Technologien
* Verhandlungssichere Deutsch\- und ösischkenntnisse  


**Benefits**

ABB Motors and Drives bietet ein umfassendes Portfolio an Motoren, Generatoren und Antriebslösungen für unterschiedlichste Industrien und Anwendungen. Hast du Lust, mit uns die Zukunft der Mobilität zu gestalten? Arval ist spezialisiert auf das Betreuen von Fahrzeugen für Firmen und Privatpersonen. Senior IT Systems \& Network Administrator
==========================================

Position Summary
----------------

We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on IT professional to take operational ownership of the school's day\-to\-day IT environment.

This is a senior, campus\- based technical position combining systems administration, enterprise networking and high\-quality user support.

The successful candidate will independently diagnose and resolve complex incidents, maintain the reliability of core IT services and anticipate issues before they disrupt teaching and learning.

They will serve as a key on\-site IT contact for staff and work closely with Regional and Global IT teams, following Group technical standards, security policies and change\-management procedures.

The role requires sound technical judgement, clear communication and the ability to plan, prioritise and

deliver work with limited day\-to\-day supervision. It is a hands\-on position rather than a people\-management role.



Key Responsibilities

**Campus IT Operations \& Technical Ownership**

* Take day\-to\-day ownership of campus IT operations, from incident triage and diagnosis through resolution, documentation and follow\-up.
* Independently prioritise support requests and operational tasks, with particular urgency for incidents affecting lessons, examinations and essential school services.
* Proactively monitor recurring issues, service health and technology risks; recommend and implement practical improvements within delegated authority.
* Act as the senior on\-site technical contact, coordinating with school stakeholders, IT colleagues and external suppliers; escalate significant incidents with clear technical evidence and business impact.


**Systems, Microsoft 365 \& Identity Management**

* Administer Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID, including users, groups, licences, role\-appropriate access permissions, authentication and account lifecycle processes.
* Operate and troubleshoot Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online, including mailboxes, collaboration services and access\-related incidents.
* Support secure identity practices, including MFA, access controls and the implementation of centrally defined security policies.
* Investigate service degradation, authentication failures and device\-to\-cloud integration issues, identifying root causes and implementing controlled fixes.


**Endpoint \& Device Management**

* Administer Windows endpoints through Microsoft Intune, including enrolment, device configuration, application deployment, policy application and troubleshooting.
* Support Apple Macs and iPads through Jamf and maintain compliant, reliable device configurations in accordance with Group standards.
* Manage provisioning, deployment, replacement, patching and end\-of\-life processes for staff and shared school devices.


**Networking \& Infrastructure**

* Provide hands\-on operation and advanced troubleshooting of the campus wired and wireless network, including switches, access points, network connectivity and related services.
* Use Cisco Meraki management and diagnostic tools, where authorised, to investigate client connectivity, switch ports, Wi\-Fi performance and infrastructure alerts.
* Diagnose issues involving TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, switching, routing fundamentals, wireless authentication and Internet connectivity; distinguish endpoint, local\-network and upstream service faults.
* Carry out approved network changes, equipment replacements and site deployments in coordination with Regional or Global IT; maintain accurate configurations and documentation.
* Work with connectivity and network service providers to restore service and prevent repeat incidents.


**User Support \& Classroom Technology**

* Provide second\-line and senior escalation support for complex Windows, Microsoft 365, endpoint, classroom AV/interactive display and peripheral issues, while remaining responsive to urgent day\-to\-day support needs.
* Help teachers and staff use school technology effectively; communicate incident status and practical workarounds in accessible, non\-technical language.
* Support PaperCut MF / Find\-Me printing and cloud telephony, coordinating specialist suppliers where required.


**Security, Documentation \& Projects**

* Maintain IT asset records, operational procedures, technical documentation and useful knowledge\-base articles.
* Contribute to refresh programmes, upgrades, onboarding/offboarding and continuous improvement projects, managing assigned on\-site activities autonomously.
* Apply information\-security, privacy and safeguarding requirements; identify and promptly escalate security incidents or risks in line with established procedures.




**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Typically 5\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience in IT support, systems administration or network operations, including demonstrable responsibility for independently managing a business or campus IT environment. Equivalent experience will be considered.
* Strong practical experience administering Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID, including identity/access management and troubleshooting Exchange Online services.
* Hands\-on experience with Windows device management using Microsoft Intune, including configuration and deployment workflows.
* Solid enterprise networking knowledge and evidence of resolving real\-world issues involving TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, switching, Wi\-Fi and network access.
* Proven ability to investigate and resolve incidents end\-to\-end, identify root causes, assess service impact and escalate efficiently when an issue exceeds the role's authority or scope.
* Ability to work independently on\-site, organise competing priorities, communicate clearly with non\-technical users and coordinate vendors and remote technical teams.
* Professional working proficiency in English (at least B2; C1 preferred).


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**

* Hands\-on administration or support of Cisco Meraki switches, wireless access points and security appliances.
* Experience using Jamf School or Jamf Pro to manage Apple Macs and iPads.
* Experience with MFA, Microsoft Conditional Access, endpoint security, PowerShell or practical IT automation.
* Familiarity with PaperCut MF, Find\-Me printing and cloud\-based VoIP services.
* Previous experience in international education or another multi\-user, service\-critical environment.
* Relevant Microsoft or networking certifications (e.g., Microsoft 365/Endpoint Administrator or CCNA), or equivalent proven expertise.
* French proficiency (B1 or above preferred; B2 a strong advantage).




**Safeguarding \& Professional Conduct**

The successful candidate must uphold the school's commitments to safeguarding and the welfare of children and young people, protect confidential information, and follow applicable data protection and information\-security policies. Appointment is subject to the relevant pre\-employment checks and applicable Swiss legal requirements.

Ref 2585117 \| Date: 13 Oct 2026

![Unilabs]( )

Senior HR Generalist

**Introduction**



Unilabs is the largest provider of medical laboratory diagnostics for prescribers and hospitals in Switzerland and employs around 800 people.



**Your Tasks**



We are looking for an experienced Senior HR Specialist to join our HR team in Dübendorf on a **10\-month fixed\-term contract.**



Core Responsibilities



1\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruiting \- 50\-65%



*      Managing the full recruitment cycle: job postings, application screening, interviews, coordination with hiring managers, and onboarding.



*      Collaborating closely with managers to define role requirements and ensure effective hiring outcomes.



*      Maintaining and improving the applicant tracking system .  





2\. HR Administration \& Employee Support



*      Acting as the first point of contact for all HR\-related administrative questions from employees



*      Independently managing personnel administration for the region, including:

  

* Drafting and issuing employment contracts, amendments, termination letters, employment confirmations, and reference letters.
  

* Processing applications for child allowances and maternity insurance.
  

* Maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date employee records and files.  
  

* **Handling correspondence with employees, external partners, and government authorities.**  


3\. HR Systems, Processes, Reporting \& Internal Coordination \- 20%



*      Acting as Key User for our ATS and related HR processes.



*      Training employees and managers on new systems and process changes, including troubleshooting support.



*      Serving as Point of Contact for internal IT and Quality departments on HR\-related topics.



*      Preparing and analyzing HR data and reports ( , headcount, FTEs, employee statistics).



**Your Profile**



You'll be a great fit if:



*      You have at least 3 years of experience in a similar HR or Talent Acquisition role.



*      You have experience in medical recruitment, life sciences, healthcare, or a related industry (a strong plus).



*      You are fluent in both German and English, written and spoken.



*      You have knowledge of Italian (a plus).



*      You are highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities independently.



*      You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.



**We Offer**



* An exciting and dynamic work environment with a lot of internationality
* Taking responsibility and unfolding your potential
* A positive working atmosphere with a partnership and appreciative corporate culture
* Attractive fringe benefits as well as a 40\-hour week and 5\-weeks vacation
* Annual fee for your personal analyses and special prices for radiological advice from the Unilabs Group


**Contact details**

title: Junior Chief of Staff (a) (80-100%)
description:
**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper. Als spezialisierte Personalberatung besetzen wir seit über 25 Jahren anspruchsvolle Fach\- und Führungspositionen. Dabei arbeiten wir branchenagnostisch mit Start\-Ups, KMUs und internationalen Grosskonzernen zusammen.**

**Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von einem familiären Miteinander, offener und manchmal etwas sehr direkter Kommunikation sowie einem starken Teamgeist. Kollegiale Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und gemeinsame Events sorgen dafür, dass Arbeit bei uns nicht nur erfolgreich, sondern auch menschlich ist.**

**Zur Unterstützung unserer beiden Co\-CEOs suchen wir ein neugieriges, lernfähiges und umsetzungsstarkes Organisationstalent mit hoher Technologieaffinität als «Junior Chief of Staff».**

**Deine Herausforderung**

Du stehst kurz vor deinem Studienabschluss oder hast diesen gerade hinter dir – und suchst keinen klassischen Einstiegsjob? Du möchtest nicht in einem Traineeprogramm eine Station von vielen durchlaufen, sondern direkt erleben, wie ein Unternehmen geführt wird?  
In dieser vielseitigen Stabsrolle erhältst du Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche eines KMUs, unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Projekte und Verantwortungsbereiche.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte sehen wie folgt aus – wobei sich deine Rolle im Laufe der Zeit verändern und weiterentwickeln wird.

* **Management Support \& Business Operations (\~40%)**
    + Du unterstützt unsere beiden Co\-CEOs im operativen Tagesgeschäft und hältst ihnen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben den Rücken frei
    + Du bereitest Präsentationen, Auswertungen, Controllings und Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf
    + Du koordinierst zentrale interne Abläufe und entwickelst bestehende Instrumente und Prozesse weiter
    + Du bist Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei organisatorischen und administrativen Fragestellungen
* **Provider Management \& Infrastruktur (\~15%)**
    + Du koordinierst schrittweise unsere externen Partner und Dienstleister, insbesondere in den Bereichen IT, LinkedIn und Jobplattformen
    + Du verwaltest zentrale Firmenaccounts, Lizenzen und Verträge und behältst Kosten, Laufzeiten und Leistungen im Blick
    + Du stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden über eine funktionierende und zeitgemässe Arbeitsumgebung verfügen
* **Marketing \& Kommunikation (\~20%)**
    + Du gestaltest unseren Unternehmensauftritt auf LinkedIn sowie weitere zentrale Kommunikationskanäle mit
    + Du verantwortest unser Newslettering und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website
    + Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Marketing\- und Kundenaktivitäten
* **Digitalisierung, AI \& Projekte (\~25%)**
    + Du treibst Projekte in den Bereichen AI, Digitalisierung und Business Development voran
    + Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen und prüfst, wie neue Tools und AI\-Anwendungen bei C\&P sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können
    + Du unterstützt die Co\-CEOs bei konzeptionellen und strategischen Projekten und bringst diese in die Umsetzung


**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder BWL (Uni/FH) abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor
* Du besitzt relevante Praxiserfahrung, die du während oder nach deinem Studium \- via Praktika, Teilzeittätigkeit oder im Rahmen einer Festanstellung \- sammeln durftest
* Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität für Technologie, Digitalisierung und AI und freust dich daran, neue Tools auszuprobieren. Dabei denkst du realistisch und weisst, dass wir keine Luftschlösser bauen und dass der konkrete Nutzen gegeben sein muss
* Du wendest die Microsoft 365 Tools gut und gerne an \- insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel
* Du magst Zahlen, bist zuverlässig und gehst die Dinge strukturiert an
* Du bist ein Organisationstalent oder willst und kannst eines werden. So oder so hast du eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, dich rasch in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.
* Du willst, dass deine Marketingaktivitäten Wirkung im Ziel haben. Das Look \& Feel ist dir dabei aber nicht egal.
* Du bist keine Diva und dir nicht zu schade, dir auch mal die Finger schmutzig zu machen und in einem KMU Aufgaben zu erledigen, die eigentlich nicht in deinem Stellenbeschrieb stehen
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
* Du bist so humorvoll, dass du zuweilen auch mal über dich selber lachen kannst


**Wir suchen kein fertiges Profil. Wir suchen jemanden am Anfang seiner oder ihrer Karriere, dem wir zutrauen, sehr schnell zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit j4id10435617jm j4it1042jm j4iy26jm**

Division Controller \& Commercial Manager High Speed (m/f/d) (80\-100%)

Business Analyst
================











  **Description**  




We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Business Analyst to strengthen our Clients, Products and (CPS) Platform team. You will act as a key link between business and IT, translating business needs into clear and scalable requirements for the applications and processes that support our client, product and sales activities: primarily for our firm\-wide CRM for deal pipeline, fundraising and investor management and our product management system.   You will also contribute to the firm's flagship change initiatives.



This role is a great fit for a professional who wants to grow quickly in a broad, high\-visibility environment at the intersection of business, data and technology, with the opportunity to take ownership and accountability for the end\-to\-end delivery of projects and enhancements (run\-the\-business).



In this role you will:



*  Gather, structure, and analyze business requirements from investment, business development, operations, and compliance teams, driving end\-to\-end change initiatives across the CPS application landscape while taking increasing ownership of delivery from requirements through go\-live and user adoption in close collaboration with business stakeholders and IT;
*  Translate business requirements into clear user stories, functional specifications, data mappings, and acceptance criteria, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, IT, and external vendors to validate and deliver effective solutions;
*  Support the continuous evolution and refactoring of the CRM (objects, fields, dashboards, workflows, permissions) with a focus on simplification, user experience and adoption;
*  Support Product management system change and data quality improvement activities: define and refine master data attributes, data quality rules and data ownership, analyze data quality incidents and drive their remediation together with the data owners;
*  Document and validate interfaces and data flows between connected systems (e.g. fund accounting, data platform, investor portal), and assess the impact of changes on downstream applications;
*  Contribute to the implementation of the client onboarding and AML/KYC platform: capture requirements, map processes, support integration design and testing, and prepare the rollout to operations and compliance teams;
*  Maintain the product backlog for the applications in your scope, support prioritization and release planning together with the application owners, coordinate and perform testing (UAT and regression) and manage the business sign\-off and approval process;
*  Map and analyze as\-is and to\-be business processes, identify pain points and opportunities for simplification and automation, and proactively drive their implementation;
*  Act as a trusted point of contact for business and IT on all matters related to CPS applications, prepare user documentation, training material and communications, and foster adoption across the firm.


Stay up to date on developments in CRM, master data management and onboarding technologies, and help identify, shape and implement AI use cases jointly with the AI teams.











**Requirements**







*  5\+ years of hands\-on or consulting experience in business analysis, CRM, data management or operations, ideally in financial services;
*  Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics or a related field;
*  understanding of business processes and the underlying data, with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and vice versa;
*  Experience with CRM systems, master data management or data quality topics is a strong plus; basic SQL and/or Power BI skills are a plus;
*  Knowledge of or interest in private markets, fund structures, investor management and/or AML/KYC and onboarding processes is a plus; awareness of data protection (GDPR/FADP) and financial regulatory requirements (AMLA/AMLR) is an advantage;
*  Experience with agile ways of working, backlog management and UAT coordination (e.g. in Azure DevOps or Jira) is a plus;
*  Self\-starter mentality with a strong drive to get things done and take ownership of tasks and projects;

Deputy School Director (Academic)
=================================







**Aiglon College** seeks to appoint a suitably qualified











Deputy School Director (Academic)
=================================



to join the school from: **23\.08\.2027**



**Your profile**



The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.



Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.



**About us**



Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not\-for\-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world\-class education in a stunning alpine setting.



The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.



There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.



**What we offer**



Aiglon is dedicated to the well\-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.



**How to apply**



Deadline for applications: **23\.10\.2026**



Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate. Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.



**Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.**



**Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.**



You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s .



**JOB PURPOSE**



The role of Deputy School Director is a key management and leadership position in the school, and they are a pivotal member of both the School Council (the leadership team) overseeing many aspects of the operational management and leadership of the School. The role is primarily concerned with the school's academic leadership, with the other Deputy School Directors leading and managing school safeguarding, wellbeing, character education and boarding functions. Additionally, the Deputy School Director is an integral part of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), working alongside the School Director, CFO/COO, and other Deputy School Directors. Aiglon, distinguished by its philosophy and ethos, prioritises the holistic development of every child. As a school committed to character development and holistic education, we prioritise the student experience and ensure their wellbeing and safety, which are fundamental to their journey at Aiglon.



**OBJECTIVES**



*      To deputise for the School Director as and when required.

  

*      To manage all academic aspects of the school.

  

*      The following list should not be considered definitive but act as a guide to those areas for which the Deputy School Director will be responsible.

  



**KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**



**MEMBERSHIP OF THE SCHOOL LEADERSHIP TEAM**



1.      To be a member of the School Council and the ELT.

  

2.      To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff and students.

  

3.      To ensure student needs and interests are placed at the forefront of all decisions made at the school.

  

4.      To be fully involved in the whole\-school strategic planning and implementing and developing the school’s vision of education.

  

5.      To be the representative and advocate for all direct reports.

  

6.      To work with all members of the School Council to ensure that students’ education is appropriate, broad, balanced and effective across all aspects of school life and that the well\-being and safeguarding of students are prioritised.

  

7.      Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.

  

8.      Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

  



**MANAGEMENT AND LEADERSHIP OF ACADEMIC ASPECTS OF THE SCHOOL, INCLUDING LEARNING, TEACHING, AND ASSESSMENT**



1.      To monitor and evaluate the quality of teaching and learning in the school and to be proactive in devising and implementing strategies for high performance in these areas.

  

2.      Oversee the school reporting structure and academic assessment plans and monitor their delivery.

  

3.      To advise the School Director on academic policy and carry overall responsibility for the school's academic life, including chairing the Academic Leadership Group and leading new initiatives such as curriculum reviews and effective academic monitoring of students.

  

4.      To act as line manager to the ALG, Academic Heads of Departments and University Advising departments.

  

5.      To oversee the Learning Support Department and monitor the provision of Learning Support.

  

6.      In conjunction with the Assistant Heads, monitor and analyse all school public examination results.

  

7.      Management of student data and trends regarding academic performance and potential, including but not limited to overseeing the analysis and dissemination of data from year group examinations (e.g. MIDYIS and ALIS) and overseeing target setting and the administration of other measures of value added and academic performance.

  



**LEADERSHIP OF STAFFING, INCLUDING RECRUITMENT**



1.      To be fully involved in recruiting new academic staff.

  

2.      To oversee the management of staff professional development days, inset and CPD (in conjunction with other members of the School Leadership Team).

  

3.      To be fully involved in new staff induction programmes (in conjunction with other members of the School Leadership Team).

  

4.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the academic staff have regular and useful performance management reviews.

  

5.      Manage the school’s PGCE programme.

  



**LEADERSHIP OF WHOLE\-SCHOOL ACCREDITATION**



1.      To line\-manage the Accreditation Coordinator and ensure that all aspects of accreditation (CIS, NEASC, and IB) are well\-organised and well\-planned and that the School Director and School Council are fully informed about the progress of accreditation.

  



**MANAGEMENT OF UNIVERSITY ADVISING**



1.      management of the Director of University Advising.

  

2.      Ensure the School Director and other members of the School Council are fully informed regarding trends and patterns and new developments in university applications.

  

3.      Ensure the School Director and other members of the School Council are fully informed regarding Year 13 university offers.

  



**MANAGEMENT OF LEARNING SUPPORT AND EXAMINATIONS**



1.      management of the Head of Learning Support

  

2.      To work with the Head of Learning Support to oversee the applications for special consideration.

  

3.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the planning and management of internal and external examinations

  

4.      To work with the Assistant Heads to ensure the accurate and timely analysis and publication of examination results

  



**MANAGEMENT OF SCHOOL EVENTS AND MARKETING MATERIALS**



1.      To work with other members of the School Council to ensure school events are well\-planned and run smoothly.

  

2.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the well\-planning of Prize Giving, Graduation, and parent\-teacher events.

  

3.      To work with other members of the School Council to ensure the Aiglon Guide is updated annually.

  

4.      To work with the Marketing and Communications team and the Director of Educational Systems to ensure Aiglon Study Guides are accurate and available to the school community.

  



**DIVERSITY, EQUALITY AND INCLUSIVITY**



1.      Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of the School’s DEIJ policies and procedures.

  



**SAFEGUARDING**



1.      Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of safeguarding legislation and the School’s safeguarding policies and procedures and liaise closely with the Safeguarding lead.

  



**HEALTH AND SAFETY**



1.      Ensure that up\-to\-date knowledge of health and safety legislation applicable to the role is maintained and that the school’s health and safety policies and procedures are fully implemented and adhered to.

  



**PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT**



1.      Maintain and update personal knowledge and skills in line with legislation and the role's needs.

  



**GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES**



1.      To be actively involved in staff recruitment as required by the School Director.

  

2.      To be on hand out of hours in the event of an emergency.

  

3.      Attend school functions and events as often as possible and support students and staff in their activities and endeavours.

  

4.      To be a teacher in their specialist area with a reduced teaching load.

  

5.      To participate in the duty rota of School Council members on certain weekends and weekend evenings.

  

6.      To be a member of the Critical Incident team.

  

7.      To undertake any other reasonable tasks delegated by the School Director.

title: Resilience & Crisis Management Researcher
description:
Einleitungstext
The Center for Security Studies (CSS) at ETH Zurich is a center of competence for Swiss and international security policy. It offers security policy expertise in research, teaching, and consultancy.

Projekthintergrund
The Think Tank of the CSS serves as a link between researchers and practitioners in the field of security policy and as a point of contact and reference for the wider public.

The Resilience and Crisis Management Team as part of the CSS Think Tank conducts research and provides policy consulting on a range of fields relating to risks and strategies to prevent, prepare, or respond to disasters and emergencies. The focus is on (a) risks (e.g., changes in the risk landscape, methods for risk assessments, natural hazards); (b) civil protection and crisis management including CBRN (e.g., processes and structures, adaptations, use of new technologies and approaches); (c) societal and socio-technical resilience (e.g., individual disaster preparedness, issues related to critical infrastructure).

Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung
As a researcher in the Resilience and Crisis Management Team, you focus on the issue areas outlined and related topics. Depending on your expertise and interests, you will build specialised knowledge and insights and help Swiss authorities address specific challenges. This also includes proactive engagement with different stakeholders, providing on-demand comprehensive policy advice, and presenting your expertise and knowledge clearly and concisely.
You will publish your findings in policy-relevant publications and disseminate your knowledge through dialogue with policymakers and other relevant stakeholders.
Ideally, you would be able to join as soon as possible.

Ihr Profil
At a minimum, you should have a MA/MSc degree in a relevant discipline (e.g. Political Science, Risk Analysis, Resilience, Crisis and Disaster Management, Security Studies, Public Policy or Environmental Sciences). Recent MA graduates are encouraged to apply. We are particularly looking for researchers who have experience and/or interest in one or more of the following research topics: (a) natural hazards and disaster risk reduction; (b) socio-technical resilience; (c) anticipation and risk analysis methods as well as risk communication. An independent, well-organised working style, along with excellent communication skills and the ability to work in an international team are essential.

The CSS is a multilingual working environment, so proficiency in English is required. Knowledge of one Swiss national language – or the willingness to acquire German language skills on the job – is an asset. Work experience in relevant international organisations, think tanks, or government agencies is an advantage, as is knowledge of the Swiss political landscape.

Wir bieten
We offer the opportunity to apply and develop research skills for resilience and crisis management topics, within the environment of a university-based think tank working on security and peace issues.
The term for the appointment is for two years, with the option of extension if there is funding and if there is mutual agreement to continue the cooperation.  
We offer a workplace in the centre of Zurich with attractive working conditions. Further training and the ability to conduct applied research, publish the results in different formats and provide your own process support related to peace mediation are part of the career development and are central elements of our personnel policy.

Neugierig? Sind wir auch.
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

CV
Letter of interest explaining the skills and motivation you would bring to the position
One to two single-authored writing samples (e.g. an academic article, policy brief, or thesis chapter – can be a draft version)
Two references to be approached (in case you are invited to an interview).
A copy of your master’s degree and any job references
Application deadline is 31 October 2026.

Further information about us can be found on our website. For questions about the position, please contact Simon Aebi, simon.aebi@sipo.gess.ethz.ch (no applications).

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

title: Head of Investor Relations
description:
**About Copenhagen Atomics**

At Copenhagen Atomics, we believe that abundant, reliable and affordable energy is fundamental to human progress.

Since 2014, we have been developing a new generation of nuclear energy technology based on thorium molten salt reactors. Our ambition is to industrialize nuclear energy through mass manufacturing, standardized reactor systems and a fundamentally different approach to deployment and economics.

Copenhagen Atomics is approaching 100 employees across Denmark and Switzerland, with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, scientists, technicians and commercial professionals.

As we enter the next phase of our growth, we are looking for an exceptional **Head of Investor Relations** to join our executive team and build the commercial organization that will bring Copenhagen Atomics technology to customers around the world.

**About the role**

Based in our Zug office, you will take a leading role in Copenhagen Atomics' investor relations and capital\-raising activities.

This is a senior, hands\-on position. You will work closely with our CEO, CFO and existing investor relations colleagues to build relationships with investors and secure the capital required for the company's continued growth.

Approximately 80% of your time will be directly related to investor engagement and capital raising: identifying prospective investors, developing relationships, presenting the Copenhagen Atomics investment case, managing fundraising processes and helping bring investment discussions to a successful close.

You will also help develop our Investor Relations organization in Zug. We expect our Swiss activities to grow significantly over the coming years, with the potential for the Zug organization to reach approximately 30 employees.

For the right candidate, this position offers substantial opportunity to grow in responsibility as the company and our international capital base expand.

**Your key responsibilities**

**Capital raising**  
Identify, engage and develop relationships with institutional investors, family offices, private investors, venture and growth investors, and other long\-term capital providers.

**Investor relationships**  
Build trusted, long\-term relationships with existing and prospective shareholders and serve as a senior point of contact between investors and Copenhagen Atomics.

**Fundraising execution**  
Work closely with the CEO and management team throughout the fundraising process—from investor identification and initial meetings through due diligence, negotiation and closing.

**Investment narrative**  
Clearly communicate Copenhagen Atomics' technology, commercial strategy, market opportunity and long\-term vision to sophisticated international investors.

**Investor materials and communication**  
Work with management, finance and communications colleagues to develop presentations, financial information, investor updates and other materials supporting our fundraising activities.

**Leadership**  
Help build and develop our Investor Relations team in Zug. Lead by example, support colleagues in making good decisions and create a culture of accountability, integrity and execution.

**International investor network**  
Expand Copenhagen Atomics' relationships with investors in Switzerland, Europe, the American and Asian markets.

**What we are looking for**

You have at least **5 years of relevant experience in capital raising, investor relations, private equity, venture capital, investment banking, corporate finance or a comparable field**.

Ideally, you have personally participated in—and successfully completed—significant equity fundraising transactions for technology, deep\-tech, energy, infrastructure or industrial companies.

You are comfortable speaking directly with sophisticated investors, entrepreneurs, family offices and institutional capital providers.

You combine strong relationship\-building skills with the ability to move discussions toward concrete decisions and transactions.

You have excellent business communication and presentation skills in **English**. Professional proficiency in **German** is highly desirable.

You are comfortable discussing financial models, company valuations, capitalization structures and investment terms with investors and advisers.

You have high personal integrity and understand that trust and credibility are fundamental to successful investor relationships.

IT\-Solution und Security Architekt:in 100%
===========================================

Du bist davon überzeugt, dass das Potential der Digitalisierung den Gesundheitsmarkt weiter revolutionieren wird, und möchtest Deine fachlichen Skills einsetzen, um das Beste für unsere Kunden herauszuholen und sie zu begeistern?

Wir sind ein stark expandierendes und innovatives KMU im Medizin\- und Bankwesen sowie im Integrationsumfeld komplexer Cloud\-Projekte. Unser Kerngeschäft in der Medizin liegt in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb der schweizweit modernsten Arztsoftware amétiq siMed und dem einzigartigen medizinischen Ökosystem amétiq cloud mit über 7’000 Benutzern. Wir sind damit die erste Adresse für die Digitalisierung der Arztpraxis entlang der gesamten Prozesskette.



**Für die Verstärkung des internen IT\-Teams suchen wir eine:n**

Deine
-----

Du hast eine Schlüsselrolle, in der Du eine hochsichere und moderne IT\-Architektur mitgestalten kannst und gleichzeitig ganz nah an der technischen Umsetzung stehst. In dieser Position schlägst Du die Brücke zwischen strategischer Architektur, stabiler Systemlandschaft und moderner Cyber\-Security. Du evaluierst zukunftsweisende Technologien, optimierst mit schrittweiser Modernisierung die Architektur für mehr Effizienz in Entwicklung und Betrieb und wirkst aktiv bei der Umsetzung mit. Dabei arbeitest Du auf Augenhöhe mit unseren System Engineers, der Administration und unserem hauseigenen Systemprovider zusammen.



Deine Aufgaben
--------------

* Architektur \& Innovation: Du konzipierst und verantwortest Optimierungen unserer IT\-Architektur, evaluierst neue Technologien und treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Infrastruktur voran.
* Security \& Identity Management: Du hältst die Sicherheit unserer Architektur auf einem hohen Niveau, sicherst Datenflüsse ab und gestaltest moderne Identitäts\- und Zugriffstrukturen (IDP).
* Hands\-on Integration: Du konzipierst nicht nur, sondern bringst Dich aktiv ein, indem Du neue Grundstrukturen direkt umsetzt und integrierst.
* System\- \& Provider\-Schnittstelle: Du arbeitest eng und partnerschaftlich mit den System Engineers sowie mit den Administratoren zusammen und steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Systemprovider im gleichen Firmenkonstrukt.
* Daten \& Analytics: Du designst und optimierst performante Datenarchitekturen für komplexe Datenbanken und datenintensive Workloads (Data Pipelining).
* Qualitäts\- \& Belastungstests: Mit Deinem Verständnis für moderne Testverfahren und Load\-Tests stellst Du die Performance und Ausfallsicherheit der Systeme unter realen Bedingungen sicher.
* Strukturen hinterfragen: Du bringst den Mut und die Expertise mit, bestehende Strukturen („Challenging von Systemen“) konstruktiv zu hinterfragen und zu optimieren.




Dein Profil
-----------

* Infrastruktur\- \& Systemnähe: Du hast eine ausgeprägte Leidenschaft für IT\-Infrastrukturen und moderne Tools; das Arbeiten nah an der operativen Systemlandschaft begeistert Dich.
* Security \& IDP\-Experte: Du verfügst über fundierte, starke Kenntnisse im Bereich IT\-Security sowie in der Konzeption und Verwaltung von Identity\-Provider\-Strukturen (vorzugsweise mit Keycloak und MS Entra).
* Daten\- \& Tool\-Know\-how: Du kennst sich bestens mit Datenbanken und Datenflüssen aus und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit Werkzeugen wie Apache Spark und Apache NiFi mit.
* Repository\- \& Code\-Verständnis: Du bist vertraut mit der strukturierten Ablage und Integration von Systemstrukturen in Software\-Repositories (z. B. Git).
* Container \& Orchestrierung: Du besitzt solide Grundkenntnisse in Kubernetes sowie im Bereich der Container\-Orchestrierung.
* Zukunftstechnologien: Du hast ein starkes Interesse an Trends wie «Künstlicher Intelligenz» (AI) und bringst die Fähigkeit mit, deren Nutzen für die Infrastruktur zu bewerten.
* Mindset: Du bist ein starker Teamplayer, der komplexe Abhängigkeiten schnell durchschaut und Freude daran hat, technologische Standards aktiv mitzugestalten.




Das erwartet Dich
-----------------

* Eine enge, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit einem etablierten Systemprovider innerhalb des gleichen Firmenkonstrukts – für kurze Wege und maximale Synergien.
* Direkter Gestaltungsspielraum mit modernen Tools und Plattformen (Kubernetes, Keycloak, Spark, Apache NiFi sowie zukunftsweisende AI\-Anwendungen).

Principal Data Architect
========================

Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and . We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. We excel in complex, regulated spaces including health and finance, connecting strategy, tech implementation, and operational services to help clients become more effective, resilient businesses.



If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey.



**Role**



As a Principal Data Architect, you will provide strategic guidance and long\-term vision across data and AI, working closely with our clients to solve complex data challenges, from platform modernisation and governance to real\-time architectures and AI operationalization. You will design and deliver data architectures and strategies that are fit for purpose, balancing technical rigour with business value, while bringing the curiosity and conviction to challenge conventional thinking and push the boundaries of what data and AI can do for our clients.



**How you’ll make impact**

* **Trusted Advisor:** You guide our clients towards successful solutions to their data challenges. You'll lead design sessions, architecture reviews, proof\-of\-concept projects and evaluation of new data technologies and vendors.
* **Early Engagement \& Vision:** You take part in pre\-sales and sales activities to help create a compelling vision for our clients' data strategy, modernisation and governance journeys, including transitions to cloud\-native data platforms, data meshes, real\-time data architectures, and AI\-native platforms.
* **Architecture \& Implementation:** You design sophisticated architectures for data and AI projects, implementing them together with your team while inspiring your stakeholders.
* **Methodology \& Concepts:** You bring rigorous methodology to every engagement, applying agile DevOps and DataOps practices to keep delivery on track, while ensuring architectural decisions are grounded in deep conceptual understanding of data platforms, data mesh, security and governance.
* **Cloud Expertise:** You feel at home in both cloud and on\-premises environments. In the cloud, you design optimal solutions on Azure, AWS, and GCP, knowing when each platform is the right fit.
* **Data Engineering:** You lead your team to success in flagship projects with solid data engineering knowledge, ensuring clean and maintainable code, efficient data models and robust pipelines.
* **AI Operationalization:** You take data and AI projects from prototype to production readiness, with a strong focus on traceability, transparency, and reproducibility as foundations for governed and compliant AI.
* **Thought Leadership \& Consulting:** You promote understanding of AI and data technologies, share your knowledge both internally and externally, and invest in growing the talent around you.




**What’s important to us**

* You bring deep expertise in AI and data solutions, along with a nuanced understanding of their possibilities and limitations.
* You have a passion for clean, maintainable software architecture in data platforms and have taken on responsibility in technical mandates in agile environments both as an architect and as an engineer within your career.
* You have proven experience leading the technical aspects of pre\-sales activities and bid management, shaping winning proposals and translating client needs into compelling solution narratives.
* You are proficient across multiple data platforms and cloud environments, including Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks and Snowflake, and are comfortable with distributed processing, data modelling, API design, containerisation, serverless computation, data governance, and data security.
* With your positive attitude and strong self\-motivation, you take responsibility for proposals, client projects and the further development of our data and AI competencies. You make confident decisions and can clearly explain your reasoning, balancing technical rigour with pragmatism to keep delivery on track.
* Excellent communication skills on management level as well as with technical experts in both and English are essential.
* You hold a technical degree in Computer Science, or a comparable field.




**What we offer**

* Work life blend: we offer a safe \& healthy workplace, with flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home
* Profit share scheme: In addition to your annual salary, you may receive a profit share defined by the company’s success in the previous year
* Global and Diverse Zühlke community: witness how colleagues from all our 16 offices across the globe come together to create a unique, positive and inclusive work culture, learning from one another at annual team camps, and celebrating year\-end parties and other local festivities.
* Committed to development: we are committed to the growth of our people and are investing in your development. We’re empowering you to build the skills you need to make a positive impact, both personally and for our clients, today and in the future.




To dive deeper into local benefits of working in **Zühlke follow****the** .
